title: 功率模組銀燒結接合
summary: 以四階段、24 步深入銀燒結頸部、孔隙與界面可靠度；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine silver sinter necks, porosity and interface reliability. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。材料廠建議是特定配方的範圍；本課不給通用壓力溫度配方，孔隙率也不能單獨預測疲勞壽命。
scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Vendor windows apply to specific formulations; no universal pressure-temperature recipe is supplied, and porosity alone does not predict fatigue life.

stages.title: 接合機制
stages.description: 本階段處理接合機制：依序完成三個技術單元的模型與獨立驗證，將物理主張連到可觀察資料。
stages.descriptionEn: Address bond mechanisms through three technical units, each with a model and independent verification linking physical claims to observable evidence.

steps.title: 辨識固態燒結
steps.objective: 建立「辨識固態燒結」的可檢驗工程模型，說明：顆粒間形成頸部及緻密化，不等同焊料液相凝固。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for identify solid-state sintering: Particle necking and densification differ from solder solidification.
steps.instruction: 先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。畫顆粒、頸部及殘餘孔隙。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Draw particles, necks and residual pores. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：畫顆粒、頸部及殘餘孔隙。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Draw particles, necks and residual pores. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：銀燒結一定完全無孔隙。本步先檢查「辨識固態燒結」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到顆粒間形成頸部及緻密化，不等同焊料液相凝固。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Silver sintering is always pore-free. First check whether evidence for identify solid-state sintering actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Particle necking and densification differ from solder solidification.
steps.check: 交付「辨識固態燒結」模型與比較圖，至少包含本步指定的操作、預測方向、量測單位及未驗證假設。
steps.checkEn: Submit the model and comparison for identify solid-state sintering, including the specified action, predicted direction, units and an unvalidated assumption.

title: 陶瓷直接覆銅基板
summary: 以四階段、24 步深入DBC 陶瓷絕緣、銅層擴散及邊缘應力；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine dbc insulation, copper heat spreading and edge stress. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。資料表典型 k 和耐壓只適用所列測試條件；DBC、AMB 與薄膜金屬化不可視為同一製程。
scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Datasheet conductivity and breakdown values apply to stated conditions; DBC, AMB and thin-film metallization are distinct processes.

knowledge.textEn: List interface materials and sources for each technology. Keep raw observations distinct from inference.

quiz.question: 在「區分接合技術」中，哪個處理方式或主張有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach or claim is physically justified for distinguish bonding technologies?
options: 所有陶瓷基板都使用同一覆銅機制
陶瓷耐壓等於整個模組耐壓
DBC 與活性金屬釬焊的界面形成機制不同。
optionsEn: All ceramic substrates use the same copper-bonding mechanism
Ceramic breakdown voltage equals module isolation rating
DBC and active-metal brazing form interfaces by different mechanisms.
quiz.explanation: DBC 與活性金屬釬焊的界面形成機制不同。 為每種技術列界面材料與來源。
quiz.explanationEn: DBC and active-metal brazing form interfaces by different mechanisms. List interface materials and sources for each technology.

steps.title: 區分接合技術：反證與驗收
steps.titleEn: Distinguish bonding technologies: challenge and acceptance
steps.objective: 以獨立證據檢驗「區分接合技術」的模型，辨別真實效應與量測或模型誤差。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the distinguish bonding technologies model with independent evidence and separate physical effects from measurement or model error.
steps.instruction: 沿用上一步模型，但先寫下什麼結果會推翻它。為每種技術列界面材料與來源。 加入一組對照或重複量測，改變一個會造成混淆的條件，將觀察分為支持、矛盾及仍不足。若只有模擬資料，清楚標成模擬，並指定下一項實物驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous model, first specifying what result would refute it. List interface materials and sources for each technology. Add a control or repeated measurement, vary one confounder, and classify observations as supporting, conflicting or insufficient. Label simulated data explicitly and specify the next physical validation.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：為每種技術列界面材料與來源。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: List interface materials and sources for each technology. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：陶瓷耐壓等於整個模組耐壓。本步先檢查「區分接合技術」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到DBC 與活性金屬釬焊的界面形成機制不同。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Ceramic breakdown voltage equals module isolation rating. First check whether evidence for distinguish bonding technologies actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: DBC and active-metal brazing form interfaces by different mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付「區分接合技術」的驗收紀錄：包含指定觀察、誤差來源、能支持的結論與一項應暫緩放行的結果。
steps.checkEn: Submit acceptance evidence for distinguish bonding technologies: the specified observation, error sources, supported conclusion and one hold condition.

stages.title: 圖案與應力
stages.description: 本階段處理圖案與應力：依序完成三個技術單元的模型與獨立驗證，將物理主張連到可觀察資料。
stages.descriptionEn: Address patterns and stress through three technical units, each with a model and independent verification linking physical claims to observable evidence.

steps.title: 分配銅圖案
steps.objective: 建立「分配銅圖案」的可檢驗工程模型，說明：不對稱覆銅使熱膨脹彎矩不平衡，增加翹曲。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for allocate copper patterns: Asymmetric copper patterns unbalance thermal bending moments and increase warpage.
steps.instruction: 先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。比較對稱與偏心銅覆蓋。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Compare symmetric and offset copper coverage. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：比較對稱與偏心銅覆蓋。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Compare symmetric and offset copper coverage. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：所有陶瓷基板都使用同一覆銅機制。本步先檢查「分配銅圖案」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到不對稱覆銅使熱膨脹彎矩不平衡，增加翹曲。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: All ceramic substrates use the same copper-bonding mechanism. First check whether evidence for allocate copper patterns actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Asymmetric copper patterns unbalance thermal bending moments and increase warpage.
steps.check: 交付「分配銅圖案」模型與比較圖，至少包含本步指定的操作、預測方向、量測單位及未驗證假設。
steps.checkEn: Submit the model and comparison for allocate copper patterns, including the specified action, predicted direction, units and an unvalidated assumption.

title: 封裝溫度循環可靠度
summary: 以四階段、24 步深入溫度循環歷史、CTE 失配及失效統計；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine thermal-cycle history, cte mismatch and failure statistics. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。加速試驗僅在機制相同時支持外推；零失效不等於無限壽命，環境熱循環與功率循環也不可直接互換。
scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Accelerated tests support extrapolation only with unchanged mechanisms; zero failures do not imply infinite life, and ambient and power cycling are distinct.

knowledge.textEn: Equal mean life can hide different early-failure tails.

knowledge.title: 比較分布而非平均：證據與判讀
knowledge.text: 比較中位數、散布與低分位區間。 記錄原始觀察和推論之間的區別。
knowledge.textEn: Compare median, spread and lower-quantile intervals. Keep raw observations distinct from inference.

quiz.question: 在「比較分布而非平均」中，哪個處理方式或主張有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach or claim is physically justified for compare distributions?
options: 零失效樣品可以證明永不失效
相同 ΔT 就代表相同疲勞條件
相同平均壽命可伴隨不同早期失效尾部。
optionsEn: Zero failed samples prove infinite life
Equal ΔT means identical fatigue conditions
Equal mean life can hide different early-failure tails.
quiz.explanation: 相同平均壽命可伴隨不同早期失效尾部。 比較中位數、散布與低分位區間。
quiz.explanationEn: Equal mean life can hide different early-failure tails. Compare median, spread and lower-quantile intervals.

steps.title: 比較分布而非平均：反證與驗收
steps.objective: 以獨立證據檢驗「比較分布而非平均」的模型，辨別真實效應與量測或模型誤差。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the compare distributions model with independent evidence and separate physical effects from measurement or model error.
steps.instruction: 沿用上一步模型，但先寫下什麼結果會推翻它。比較中位數、散布與低分位區間。 加入一組對照或重複量測，改變一個會造成混淆的條件，將觀察分為支持、矛盾及仍不足。若只有模擬資料，清楚標成模擬，並指定下一項實物驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous model, first specifying what result would refute it. Compare median, spread and lower-quantile intervals. Add a control or repeated measurement, vary one confounder, and classify observations as supporting, conflicting or insufficient. Label simulated data explicitly and specify the next physical validation.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：比較中位數、散布與低分位區間。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Compare median, spread and lower-quantile intervals. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：相同 ΔT 就代表相同疲勞條件。本步先檢查「比較分布而非平均」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到相同平均壽命可伴隨不同早期失效尾部。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Equal ΔT means identical fatigue conditions. First check whether evidence for compare distributions actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Equal mean life can hide different early-failure tails.
steps.check: 交付「比較分布而非平均」的驗收紀錄：包含指定觀察、誤差來源、能支持的結論與一項應暫緩放行的結果。
steps.checkEn: Submit acceptance evidence for compare distributions: the specified observation, error sources, supported conclusion and one hold condition.

stages.title: 外推與驗收
stages.description: 本階段處理外推與驗收：依序完成三個技術單元的模型與獨立驗證，將物理主張連到可觀察資料。
stages.descriptionEn: Address extrapolation and acceptance through three technical units, each with a model and independent verification linking physical claims to observable evidence.

steps.title: 確認失效機制
steps.objective: 建立「確認失效機制」的可檢驗工程模型，說明：裂紋位置、金屬間化合物與基板裂損需要分開分類。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for confirm failure mechanism: Crack location, intermetallic damage and substrate fracture need separate classes.
steps.instruction: 先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。為每一失效附截面或等效證據。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Attach section or equivalent evidence to each failure class. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：為每一失效附截面或等效證據。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Attach section or equivalent evidence to each failure class. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：零失效樣品可以證明永不失效。本步先檢查「確認失效機制」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到裂紋位置、金屬間化合物與基板裂損需要分開分類。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Zero failed samples prove infinite life. First check whether evidence for confirm failure mechanism actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Crack location, intermetallic damage and substrate fracture need separate classes.
steps.check: 交付「確認失效機制」模型與比較圖，至少包含本步指定的操作、預測方向、量測單位及未驗證假設。
steps.checkEn: Submit the model and comparison for confirm failure mechanism, including the specified action, predicted direction, units and an unvalidated assumption.

title: 封裝濕氣敏感度分析
summary: 以四階段、24 步深入水分擴散、界面剝離與回焊蒸汽壓；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine moisture diffusion, delamination and reflow vapor pressure. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。本課不是 MSL 標準替代品；實際等級、烘烤與回焊條件須依封裝規格及現行標準。
scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. This course does not replace MSL standards; actual classification, bake and reflow conditions require package specifications and current standards.

steps.objectiveEn: Test the control test confounding model with independent evidence and separate physical effects from measurement or model error.
steps.instruction: 沿用上一步模型，但先寫下什麼結果會推翻它。設乾燥與吸濕配對組。 加入一組對照或重複量測，改變一個會造成混淆的條件，將觀察分為支持、矛盾及仍不足。若只有模擬資料，清楚標成模擬，並指定下一項實物驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous model, first specifying what result would refute it. Create paired dry and moisture-conditioned groups. Add a control or repeated measurement, vary one confounder, and classify observations as supporting, conflicting or insufficient. Label simulated data explicitly and specify the next physical validation.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：設乾燥與吸濕配對組。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Create paired dry and moisture-conditioned groups. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：烘乾後所有剝離都會自動癒合。本步先檢查「控制試驗混淆」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到不同回焊歷史或材料批次會混淆水分效應。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Drying automatically heals all delamination. First check whether evidence for control test confounding actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Different reflow histories or lots confound moisture effects.
steps.check: 交付「控制試驗混淆」的驗收紀錄：包含指定觀察、誤差來源、能支持的結論與一項應暫緩放行的結果。
steps.checkEn: Submit acceptance evidence for control test confounding: the specified observation, error sources, supported conclusion and one hold condition.

knowledge.title: 控制試驗混淆：機制
knowledge.text: 不同回焊歷史或材料批次會混淆水分效應。
knowledge.textEn: Different reflow histories or lots confound moisture effects.

knowledge.titleEn: Control test confounding: evidence and interpretation
knowledge.text: 設乾燥與吸濕配對組。 記錄原始觀察和推論之間的區別。
knowledge.textEn: Create paired dry and moisture-conditioned groups. Keep raw observations distinct from inference.

quiz.question: 在「控制試驗混淆：反證與驗收」中，哪個處理方式或主張有物理依據？

options: 設乾燥與吸濕配對組。
吸水重量相同代表局部水分分布相同
烘乾後所有剝離都會自動癒合
optionsEn: Create paired dry and moisture-conditioned groups.
Equal absorbed mass means identical local moisture distribution
Drying automatically heals all delamination

stages.title: 保管與證據
stages.description: 本階段處理保管與證據：依序完成三個技術單元的模型與獨立驗證，將物理主張連到可觀察資料。
stages.descriptionEn: Address storage and evidence through three technical units, each with a model and independent verification linking physical claims to observable evidence.

steps.title: 評估乾燥與再吸濕
steps.objective: 建立「評估乾燥與再吸濕」的可檢驗工程模型，說明：乾燥移除水分但不必然逆轉已形成裂紋或腐蝕。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for assess drying and reabsorption: Drying removes moisture but need not reverse cracks or corrosion.
steps.instruction: 先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。比較乾燥前後的結構及水分指標。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Compare structure and moisture indicators before and after drying. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：比較乾燥前後的結構及水分指標。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Compare structure and moisture indicators before and after drying. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：吸水重量相同代表局部水分分布相同。本步先檢查「評估乾燥與再吸濕」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到乾燥移除水分但不必然逆轉已形成裂紋或腐蝕。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Equal absorbed mass means identical local moisture distribution. First check whether evidence for assess drying and reabsorption actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Drying removes moisture but need not reverse cracks or corrosion.
steps.check: 交付「評估乾燥與再吸濕」模型與比較圖，至少包含本步指定的操作、預測方向、量測單位及未驗證假設。
steps.checkEn: Submit the model and comparison for assess drying and reabsorption, including the specified action, predicted direction, units and an unvalidated assumption.

title: 焊點疲勞壽命建模
summary: 以四階段、24 步深入焊點蠕變、疲勞能量及模型外推；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine solder creep, fatigue energy and model extrapolation. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。Coffin–Manson 與能量法係數需要材料和試驗校準；本課算例只展示比例敏感度，不產生可保證的服役壽命。
scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Coffin–Manson and energy-model coefficients require material/test calibration; examples show sensitivity, not guaranteed service life.

steps.instruction: 沿用上一步模型，但先寫下什麼結果會推翻它。畫一個具遲滯的應力應變迴圈。 加入一組對照或重複量測，改變一個會造成混淆的條件，將觀察分為支持、矛盾及仍不足。若只有模擬資料，清楚標成模擬，並指定下一項實物驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous model, first specifying what result would refute it. Draw a hysteretic stress-strain loop. Add a control or repeated measurement, vary one confounder, and classify observations as supporting, conflicting or insufficient. Label simulated data explicitly and specify the next physical validation.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：畫一個具遲滯的應力應變迴圈。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Draw a hysteretic stress-strain loop. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：線彈性最大應力可完整預測焊料循環壽命。本步先檢查「區分應力與應變」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到焊料高溫鬆弛可降低應力而累積非彈性應變。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Peak linear-elastic stress completely predicts solder life. First check whether evidence for separate stress and strain actually supports the mechanism. steps.check: 交付「區分應力與應變」的驗收紀錄：包含指定觀察、誤差來源、能支持的結論與一項應暫緩放行的結果。
steps.checkEn: Submit acceptance evidence for separate stress and strain: the specified observation, error sources, supported conclusion and one hold condition.

steps.instruction: 先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。記錄材料來源與校準範圍。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Record material source and calibration range. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.

steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: All solders share the same fatigue constants. First check whether evidence for select constitutive model actually supports the mechanism. steps.check: 交付「選擇材料模型」模型與比較圖，至少包含本步指定的操作、預測方向、量測單位及未驗證假設。
steps.checkEn: Submit the model and comparison for select constitutive model, including the specified action, predicted direction, units and an unvalidated assumption.

title: 封裝聲學顯微檢測
summary: 以四階段、24 步深入聲阻抗、飛行時間與 C-SAM 界面圖；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine acoustic impedance, time of flight and c-sam interface maps. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。影像亮度取決於閘門、頻率與相位；暗區或亮區不具有普遍固定的缺陷含義，水耦合亦需評估樣品相容性。
scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Brightness depends on gate, frequency and phase; bright/dark regions have no universal defect meaning, and water coupling requires sample compatibility.

title: 封裝 X 光電腦斷層檢測
summary: 以四階段、24 步深入X-ray CT 投影、體素與重建偽影；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine x-ray ct projections, voxels and reconstruction artifacts. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。體素尺寸不等於解析度；CT 未見缺陷不表示界面無裂縫，尤其薄而低對比缺陷須用其他方法交叉驗證。
scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Voxel size is not resolution; absent CT contrast does not prove a crack-free interface, especially for thin low-contrast defects.

stages.title: 掃描與重建
stages.description: 本階段處理掃描與重建：依序完成三個技術單元的模型與獨立驗證，將物理主張連到可觀察資料。
stages.descriptionEn: Address scanning and reconstruction through three technical units, each with a model and independent verification linking physical claims to observable evidence.

steps.title: 設計角度採樣
steps.objective: 建立「設計角度採樣」的可檢驗工程模型，說明：投影不足或有限角度可產生方向性偽影。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for design angular sampling: Insufficient or limited-angle views create directional artifacts.
steps.instruction: 先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。比較完整旋轉與受限旋轉假想結果。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Compare full-rotation and limited-rotation results. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：比較完整旋轉與受限旋轉假想結果。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Compare full-rotation and limited-rotation results. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：更小體素必定有同等更高解析度。本步先檢查「設計角度採樣」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到投影不足或有限角度可產生方向性偽影。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Smaller voxels always give proportionally higher resolution. First check whether evidence for design angular sampling actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Insufficient or limited-angle views create directional artifacts.
steps.check: 交付「設計角度採樣」模型與比較圖，至少包含本步指定的操作、預測方向、量測單位及未驗證假設。
steps.checkEn: Submit the model and comparison for design angular sampling, including the specified action, predicted direction, units and an unvalidated assumption.

steps.title: 設計角度採樣：反證與驗收

steps.objective: 以獨立證據檢驗「設計角度採樣」的模型，辨別真實效應與量測或模型誤差。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the design angular sampling model with independent evidence and separate physical effects from measurement or model error.
steps.instruction: 沿用上一步模型，但先寫下什麼結果會推翻它。比較完整旋轉與受限旋轉假想結果。 加入一組對照或重複量測，改變一個會造成混淆的條件，將觀察分為支持、矛盾及仍不足。若只有模擬資料，清楚標成模擬，並指定下一項實物驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous model, first specifying what result would refute it. Compare full-rotation and limited-rotation results. Add a control or repeated measurement, vary one confounder, and classify observations as supporting, conflicting or insufficient. Label simulated data explicitly and specify the next physical validation.

steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Compare full-rotation and limited-rotation results. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：重建亮環一定是材料實體。本步先檢查「設計角度採樣」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到投影不足或有限角度可產生方向性偽影。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: A reconstructed bright ring must be real material. First check whether evidence for design angular sampling actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Insufficient or limited-angle views create directional artifacts.
steps.check: 交付「設計角度採樣」的驗收紀錄：包含指定觀察、誤差來源、能支持的結論與一項應暫緩放行的結果。
steps.checkEn: Submit acceptance evidence for design angular sampling: the specified observation, error sources, supported conclusion and one hold condition.

title: 矽光子 SOI 波導製作
titleEn: SOI waveguide fabrication for silicon photonics
summary: 以四階段、24 步深入SOI 波導侷限、側壁散射與 cutback；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine soi confinement, sidewall scattering and cutback. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。波導尺寸須依實際 PDK；本課不把單一公開截面當成所有代工廠共通設計規則。
scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. title: 氮化矽低損耗波導
summary: 以四階段、24 步深入SiN 低損耗、薄膜應力與吸收頻譜；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine sin low loss, film stress and absorption spectra. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。不同沉積與退火路徑不可互換；低損耗紀錄屬特定波長與製程，不是所有 SiN 元件的保證。
scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. title: 次波長光柵波導
summary: 以四階段、24 步深入SWG Bloch 模態、填充比與頻散；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine swg bloch modes, fill factor and dispersion. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。有效介質只在適當次波長及緩變條件近似成立；接近 Bragg 區或尖銳不連續處需全波/Bloch 分析。
scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Effective medium is approximate in a suitable subwavelength, slowly varying regime; near Bragg conditions or discontinuities use full-wave/Bloch analysis.

stages.descriptionEn: Address period and effective medium through three technical units, each with a model and independent verification linking physical claims to observable evidence.

title: 光柵耦合器設計
summary: 以四階段、24 步深入光柵相位匹配、方向性與模場重疊；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine grating phase matching, directionality and modal overlap. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。簡化光柵方程只給初始週期；最佳效率需考慮向下輻射、反射、有限孔徑、偏振與實際纖芯模場。
scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. The simple grating equation only seeds period; efficiency also depends on downward radiation, reflection, aperture, polarization and fiber fields.

stages.descriptionEn: Address phase and fiber through three technical units, each with a model and independent verification linking physical claims to observable evidence.

steps.instruction:
先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。重算 1 μm 偏移的 1.09 dB 例。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。

相同高斯模場假設 η=exp[−(Δx/w)²]，w=2 μm、偏移 1 μm 時 η=0.779、損耗 1.09 dB；w 為 1/e² 強度半徑。

Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Recalculate 1.09 dB loss at 1 μm offset. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.

steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for assess facet damage: Dicing cracks and debris scatter light; realignment cannot repair them.
steps.instruction: 先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。比較端面影像與對準掃描形狀。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Compare facet images with alignment-scan shapes. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：比較端面影像與對準掃描形狀。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Compare facet images with alignment-scan shapes. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：錐尖越窄就一定越低損耗。本步先檢查「評估端面損傷」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到切割微裂與碎屑可造成散射，對準重試不能修復。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: A narrower taper tip always gives lower loss. First check whether evidence for assess facet damage actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Dicing cracks and debris scatter light; realignment cannot repair them.
steps.check: 交付「評估端面損傷」模型與比較圖，至少包含本步指定的操作、預測方向、量測單位及未驗證假設。

title: 光纖陣列主動對準
summary: 以多軸光纖陣列搜尋、功率正規化與固定後漂移為主軸，完成 4 階段、24 項模型與判讀作業；包含定量算例、量測基準、失效區分與封裝交接。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 modeling/diagnostic work packages address Multiaxis fiber-array search, normalized power and post-attach drift, with quantitative examples, measurement references, failure discrimination and package handoff.
scope: 公開原理與可重算假想算例；不是代工廠配方、設備設定或產品合格界限。代表照片與概念圖不能當作每一步的實物製程影像。
scopeEn: Public principles and reproducible hypothetical examples, not foundry recipes, tool settings or product acceptance limits. Representative photos and concept diagrams are not images of each actual process operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設兩個相同 Gaussian 模態的強度 1/e² 半徑 w=2 μm，橫向偏移 d=1 μm，η=exp[−(d/w)²]=0.7788，單一偏移損耗 1.086 dB。若 d 降到 0.5 μm，損耗為 0.271 dB；均未含角度、端面反射及模態尺寸差。
workedExample.textEn: For identical Gaussian modes with 1/e² intensity radius w=2 μm and lateral offset d=1 μm, η=exp[−(d/w)²]=0.7788 and offset loss is 1.086 dB. Reducing d to 0.5 μm gives 0.271 dB, excluding angle, facet reflection and size mismatch.
workedExample.assumptions: 功率最大化不是幾何位置校準；雷射漂移、偏振、探測器飽和和多通道權重都可能改變搜尋結果。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Power maximization is not geometric calibration; laser drift, polarization, detector saturation and channel weighting can alter the search.

knowledge.title: 定量算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 假設兩個相同 Gaussian 模態的強度 1/e² 半徑 w=2 μm，橫向偏移 d=1 μm，η=exp[−(d/w)²]=0.7788，單一偏移損耗 1.086 dB。若 d 降到 0.5 μm，損耗為 0.271 dB；均未含角度、端面反射及模態尺寸差。 功率最大化不是幾何位置校準；雷射漂移、偏振、探測器飽和和多通道權重都可能改變搜尋結果。

Power maximization is not geometric calibration; laser drift, polarization, detector saturation and channel weighting can alter the search.

summaryEn: Four stages and 24 modeling/diagnostic work packages address V-groove datums, core eccentricity and tolerance stacks, with quantitative examples, measurement references, failure discrimination and package handoff.
scope: 公開原理與可重算假想算例；不是代工廠配方、設備設定或產品合格界限。代表照片與概念圖不能當作每一步的實物製程影像。

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設三個獨立零均值位置標準差為 0.3、0.4、0.2 μm，合成 σ=√(0.3²+0.4²+0.2²)=0.539 μm；若另有 0.8 μm 系統偏差，它必須獨立保留，不能放進 RSS 後當作可抵消誤差。
workedExample.textEn: Assume independent zero-mean position standard deviations 0.3, 0.4 and 0.2 μm: combined σ=0.539 μm. A separate 0.8 μm systematic bias must remain explicit; it is not a canceling random RSS term.
workedExample.assumptions: 機械公差模型需有同一座標與相關性假設；V 溝可定位包層，不會自動量到纖芯和光學模態中心。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Mechanical tolerances need common coordinates and covariance assumptions; a V-groove locates cladding, not automatically the core or optical-mode center.
workedExample.sourceScope: 本算例數值自行設定；來源支援原理，不提供這組產品規格。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Example values are independently chosen; sources support principles, not these product specifications.

steps.title: 設定機械與光學基準：模型與設計
steps.titleEn: Set mechanical and optical datums: model and design
steps.objective: 建立設定機械與光學基準的可驗證模型及適用邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a verifiable model and validity boundary for set mechanical and optical datums.
steps.instruction: 先標出「設定機械與光學基準」的座標、光／電／熱輸入與輸出。晶片邊緣不一定與波導端點共線；裝配需定義可量測的基準轉換。 用至少兩個設計狀態比較本單元變數，寫出能被量測推翻的預測；在工作台依師傅示意判讀相關介面，保留假設與未知參數。
steps.instructionEn: Mark the coordinates and optical/electrical/thermal inputs and outputs for set mechanical and optical datums. The chip edge need not coincide with waveguide endpoints; assembly requires measurable datum transforms. Compare at least two design states and write a prediction that measurement could falsify. Review the relevant interfaces with the mentor view and preserve assumptions and unknown parameters.
steps.observation: 把圖面基準、視覺標記與模態中心標在同一圖上。
steps.observationEn: Mark drawing datums, vision marks and mode centers in one coordinate map.
steps.failure: 錯誤推論「晶片切邊就是光學中心的精確基準」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
steps.failureEn: The incorrect inference "A diced edge is an exact optical-center datum" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.
steps.check: 提交設定機械與光學基準的變數表、兩種狀態與量測判別紀錄：把圖面基準、視覺標記與模態中心標在同一圖上。 寫明剩餘不確定度與不支持的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit variables, two states and a measurement-discrimination record for set mechanical and optical datums: Mark drawing datums, vision marks and mode centers in one coordinate map. State remaining uncertainty and unsupported conclusions.

knowledge.text: 假設三個獨立零均值位置標準差為 0.3、0.4、0.2 μm，合成 σ=√(0.3²+0.4²+0.2²)=0.539 μm；若另有 0.8 μm 系統偏差，它必須獨立保留，不能放進 RSS 後當作可抵消誤差。 機械公差模型需有同一座標與相關性假設；V 溝可定位包層，不會自動量到纖芯和光學模態中心。

knowledge.text: 假設兩條自由路徑的 Δα=15 ppm/K、長度 L=4 mm、ΔT=60 K，自由伸長差 Δu=3.6 μm。若此差全部投影成相同 Gaussian 模態 w=3 μm 的橫向位移，損耗 4.343(3.6/3)²=6.25 dB；實際黏著結構需另解約束和位移方向，不能把 6.25 dB 當實測值。 體積收縮率不是線性收縮率；小且各向同性時線收縮約為體積收縮的三分之一，但受約束膠層不能直接套用自由收縮位移。

steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，執行下列資料判讀：比較共同線寬偏移與兩臂差動偏移，找不同失效特徵。 將原始量、單位、量測參考面與重複性分欄記錄；比較預測與觀察，說明能排除「所有尺寸誤差只會等量增加損耗」的直接證據，再決定接受、重測或修模。 假想輸入 1 mW，目標端口功率 0.800 mW、洩漏端口 0.008 mW，端口消光比 10log10(0.800/0.008)=20 dB；兩端口總傳輸 0.808 對應 0.926 dB 損耗。消光比和總傳輸是不同量，尚未單獨量出偏振旋轉效率。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and perform this data review: Compare common width bias with differential arm bias and identify distinct signatures. Record raw values, units, reference planes and repeatability separately. Compare prediction with observation and identify direct evidence rejecting "Every dimensional error simply adds the same loss" before accepting, remeasuring or revising. With hypothetical 1 mW input, 0.800 mW desired-port and 0.008 mW leakage power give 20 dB port extinction. Total transmission 0.808 implies 0.926 dB loss. Extinction and total transmission differ; rotation efficiency is not separately determined.
steps.observation: 比較共同線寬偏移與兩臂差動偏移，找不同失效特徵。
steps.observationEn: Compare common width bias with differential arm bias and identify distinct signatures.
steps.failure: 錯誤推論「所有尺寸誤差只會等量增加損耗」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
steps.failureEn: The incorrect inference "Every dimensional error simply adds the same loss" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.
steps.check: 提交建立製程角點的變數表、兩種狀態與量測判別紀錄：比較共同線寬偏移與兩臂差動偏移，找不同失效特徵。 寫明剩餘不確定度與不支持的結論。

knowledge.title: 量測如何區分解釋

knowledge.textEn: Compare common width bias with differential arm bias and identify distinct signatures. Do not infer: Every dimensional error simply adds the same loss

knowledge.title: 定量算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 假想輸入 1 mW，目標端口功率 0.800 mW、洩漏端口 0.008 mW，端口消光比 10log10(0.800/0.008)=20 dB；兩端口總傳輸 0.808 對應 0.926 dB 損耗。消光比和總傳輸是不同量，尚未單獨量出偏振旋轉效率。 端口功率、偏振純度與高階模態含量必須分別定義；僅測總功率不能證明 TE/TM 旋轉。

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設無損對稱雙波導的超模傳播常數差 Δβ=0.04 μm⁻¹，κ=Δβ/2=0.02 μm⁻¹。交叉功率 sin²(κL)，第一次全轉移長度 π/Δβ=78.54 μm，第一次均分長度 π/(2Δβ)=39.27 μm；完整拍長 2π/Δβ=157.08 μm。
workedExample.textEn: For hypothetical lossless symmetric guides, supermode difference Δβ=0.04 μm⁻¹ gives κ=0.02 μm⁻¹. Cross power is sin²(κL); first full transfer is at 78.54 μm, first equal split at 39.27 μm, and full beat length is 157.08 μm.
workedExample.assumptions: 簡式假設相同單模波導、固定耦合係數與無損；彎曲入口、非對稱、色散及輻射需另建模。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: The reduced equation assumes identical single-mode guides, constant coupling and no loss; bends, asymmetry, dispersion and radiation need separate treatment.
workedExample.sourceScope: 本算例數值自行設定；來源支援原理，不提供這組產品規格。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Example values are independently chosen; sources support principles, not these product specifications.

knowledge.title: 定量算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 假設無損對稱雙波導的超模傳播常數差 Δβ=0.04 μm⁻¹，κ=Δβ/2=0.02 μm⁻¹。交叉功率 sin²(κL)，第一次全轉移長度 π/Δβ=78.54 μm，第一次均分長度 π/(2Δβ)=39.27 μm；完整拍長 2π/Δβ=157.08 μm。 簡式假設相同單模波導、固定耦合係數與無損；彎曲入口、非對稱、色散及輻射需另建模。

Cross power is sin²(κL); first full transfer is at 78.54 μm, first equal split at 39.27 μm, and full beat length is 157.08 μm. The reduced equation assumes identical single-mode guides, constant coupling and no loss; bends, asymmetry, dispersion and radiation need separate treatment.

summary: 以MZI 相位—強度轉換、偏壓與行波電極為主軸，完成 4 階段、24 項模型與判讀作業；包含定量算例、量測基準、失效區分與封裝交接。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 modeling/diagnostic work packages address MZI phase-to-intensity conversion, bias and traveling-wave electrodes, with quantitative examples, measurement references, failure discrimination and package handoff.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設無損平衡 MZI 的單臂 Δn_eff=10⁻⁴、L=1 mm、λ=1550 nm，Δφ=2πΔn_effL/λ=0.4054 rad。由亮態偏移時正規化輸出 cos²(Δφ/2)=0.9595；單臂 π 相移需 Δn_eff=λ/(2L)=7.75×10⁻⁴。

workedExample.assumptionsEn: The example omits arm loss, splitter imbalance, electrode propagation and carrier absorption; bright-state response differs from small-signal response at quadrature.

summaryEn: Four stages and 24 modeling/diagnostic work packages address Ring resonance, coupling conditions, linewidth and modulation drift, with quantitative examples, measurement references, failure discrimination and package handoff.
scope: 公開原理與可重算假想算例；不是代工廠配方、設備設定或產品合格界限。代表照片與概念圖不能當作每一步的實物製程影像。

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設 r=10 μm、n_g=4、λ=1550 nm，周長 62.832 μm，局部 FSR≈λ²/(n_g·2πr)=9.559 nm。載入 Q=10000 對應線寬 λ/Q=0.155 nm；假想漂移係數 80 pm/K、升溫 2 K 造成 0.160 nm 位移，約一個線寬。
workedExample.textEn: For hypothetical r=10 μm, n_g=4 and λ=1550 nm, circumference is 62.832 μm and local FSR≈9.559 nm. Loaded Q=10000 gives 0.155 nm linewidth. An assumed 80 pm/K drift over 2 K shifts resonance 0.160 nm, about one linewidth.
workedExample.assumptions: FSR 用群折射率，Q 為載入值；局部波長近似不涵蓋跨大頻帶色散。漂移係數自行設定，不是所有矽微環的材料常數。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: FSR uses group index and Q is loaded; the local wavelength approximation omits broad-band dispersion. The chosen drift coefficient is not universal for silicon rings.
workedExample.sourceScope: 本算例數值自行設定；來源支援原理，不提供這組產品規格。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Example values are independently chosen; sources support principles, not these product specifications.

summary: 以Ge 吸收、載子收集與光電量測基準為主軸，完成 4 階段、24 項模型與判讀作業；包含定量算例、量測基準、失效區分與封裝交接。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 modeling/diagnostic work packages address Ge absorption, carrier collection and optoelectronic reference planes, with quantitative examples, measurement references, failure discrimination and package handoff.
scope: 公開原理與可重算假想算例；不是代工廠配方、設備設定或產品合格界限。代表照片與概念圖不能當作每一步的實物製程影像。
scopeEn: Public principles and reproducible hypothetical examples, not foundry recipes, tool settings or product acceptance limits. Representative photos and concept diagrams are not images of each actual process operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設 1550 nm 光、外部量子效率 η=0.80（以指定晶片端口功率為基準），R=ηqλ/(hc)≈ηλ(μm)/1.23984=1.000 A/W。100 μW 入射產生約 100 μA 光電流；若暗電流 1 μA，總讀值約 101 μA，計算 R 前需扣除暗值。
workedExample.textEn: For hypothetical 1550 nm light and external quantum efficiency 0.80 referenced to a defined chip port, R=ηqλ/(hc)≈1.000 A/W. A 100 μW input gives about 100 μA photocurrent; with 1 μA dark current the total is about 101 μA, requiring dark subtraction.
workedExample.assumptions: 外部量子效率已包含所定參考面到收集電流的損失；內部效率、吸收比例與封裝入射功率不可混用。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: External efficiency includes losses between the defined reference plane and collected current; internal efficiency, absorption fraction and package-input power must not be conflated.
workedExample.sourceScope: 本算例數值自行設定；來源支援原理，不提供這組產品規格。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Example values are independently chosen; sources support principles, not these product specifications.

summary: 以Ge 吸收／Si 乘增分工、增益與過量噪聲為主軸，完成 4 階段、24 項模型與判讀作業；包含定量算例、量測基準、失效區分與封裝交接。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 modeling/diagnostic work packages address Ge absorption/Si multiplication, gain and excess noise, with quantitative examples, measurement references, failure discrimination and package handoff.
scope: 公開原理與可重算假想算例；不是代工廠配方、設備設定或產品合格界限。代表照片與概念圖不能當作每一步的實物製程影像。
scopeEn: Public principles and reproducible hypothetical examples, not foundry recipes, tool settings or product acceptance limits. Representative photos and concept diagrams are not images of each actual process operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假想單位增益光電流 I₀=5 μA、M=10，平均乘增光電流 50 μA。電子注入局部模型取 k=β/α=0.10（電洞／電子游離係數比），F=kM+(1−k)(2−1/M)=2.71；初級光電流散粒噪聲的單邊功率譜密度為 2qI₀M²F，不是只乘 M。

summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate crystal orientation, electro-optic overlap and heterogeneous interfaces, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.

scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 教學假設 VπL=2 V·cm，L=5 mm=0.5 cm，則 Vπ=4 V；改為 2.5 mm 得 8 V。這只比較相移效率，沒有估算終端或射頻損失。
workedExample.textEn: Assume VπL=2 V·cm and L=5 mm=0.5 cm, giving Vπ=4 V; 2.5 mm gives 8 V. This compares phase efficiency without termination or RF loss.
workedExample.assumptions: 電極定義、偏振及波長固定；不能把教學 VπL 視為商用品規格。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Fix electrode definition, polarization and wavelength; the teaching VπL is not a commercial specification.

steps.instruction: 先以師傅示意確認「晶軸與偏振」的輸入、輸出與座標，再在學徒工作台完成對應元件或資料流的排列。鈮酸鋰的電光響應是張量；晶切面、光偏振與電場方向共同決定有效係數。 用本單元的變數畫出至少兩種設計狀態，說明它們在「旋轉座標後重新投影電場與偏振，檢查是否誤把最大張量分量套到所有方向。」的驗證中應有何差異；把待量測參數另列，不以動畫位置當成實際公差。
steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for crystal axes and polarization, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. Lithium niobate has a tensor electro-optic response; cut, optical polarization and field direction determine the effective coefficient. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Rotate the coordinates and reproject field and polarization to detect misuse of the largest tensor component. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances.
steps.observation: 旋轉座標後重新投影電場與偏振，檢查是否誤把最大張量分量套到所有方向。
steps.observationEn: Rotate the coordinates and reproject field and polarization to detect misuse of the largest tensor component.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：鈮酸鋰每個晶向有相同電光係數。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Lithium niobate has the same electro-optic coefficient in every direction. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交晶軸與偏振的兩狀態模型、變數表，以及能由「旋轉座標後重新投影電場與偏振，檢查是否誤把最大張量分量套到所有方向。」反駁模型的預測。

title: III-V 雷射與矽晶片接合
titleEn: III-V laser bonding to silicon chips
summary: 從增益模態、接合界面與雷射熱路拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate gain modes, bonding interfaces and laser heat paths, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設 III-V 輸出 10 mW，介面損失 1.5 dB、波導損失 0.5 dB，矽端功率=10×10^(-2/10)=6.31 mW；兩個獨立標準不確定度各 0.1 dB，總損失 u≈0.141 dB。
workedExample.textEn: Assume 10 mW from III-V, 1.5 dB interface loss and 0.5 dB waveguide loss. Silicon-side power is 10×10^(-2/10)=6.31 mW. Two independent 0.1 dB standard uncertainties give u≈0.141 dB for total loss.
workedExample.assumptions: 功率參考面固定、被動損失以 dB 相加；雷射回饋與非線性自熱未納入算例。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Fix power reference planes and add passive losses in dB; feedback and nonlinear self-heating are excluded.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units address Electrothermal behavior and noise through six separately saved modeling and verification work packages.

steps.title: 電流展布：模型與設計
steps.objective: 以「電流展布」建立可檢驗的物理模型，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a falsifiable physical model for current spreading, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先以師傅示意確認「電流展布」的輸入、輸出與座標，再在學徒工作台完成對應元件或資料流的排列。接觸電阻及電流擁擠會造成局部溫升，平均電流密度不足以描述熱點。 用本單元的變數畫出至少兩種設計狀態，說明它們在「將電壓降與熱像位置對照，區分光學吸收和接觸發熱。」的驗證中應有何差異；把待量測參數另列，不以動畫位置當成實際公差。
steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for current spreading, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. Contact resistance and current crowding create local heating; mean current density misses hot spots. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Correlate voltage drop with thermal position to distinguish absorption from contact heating. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances.
steps.observation: 將電壓降與熱像位置對照，區分光學吸收和接觸發熱。
steps.observationEn: Correlate voltage drop with thermal position to distinguish absorption from contact heating.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：封裝外殼溫度永遠等於接面溫度。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Case temperature always equals junction temperature. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交電流展布的兩狀態模型、變數表，以及能由「將電壓降與熱像位置對照，區分光學吸收和接觸發熱。」反駁模型的預測。
steps.checkEn: Submit two model states and a variable table for current spreading, plus a falsifiable prediction using: Correlate voltage drop with thermal position to distinguish absorption from contact heating.

knowledge.title: 本單元物理機制
knowledge.text: 接觸電阻及電流擁擠會造成局部溫升，平均電流密度不足以描述熱點。
knowledge.textEn: Contact resistance and current crowding create local heating; mean current density misses hot spots.

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與證據
knowledge.text: 將電壓降與熱像位置對照，區分光學吸收和接觸發熱。
knowledge.textEn: Correlate voltage drop with thermal position to distinguish absorption from contact heating.

knowledge.title: 量化模型與適用邊界
knowledge.text: Pout=Pin×10^(-IL/10)；ΔT≈PheatRth 只用於線性穩態熱路。 功率參考面固定、被動損失以 dB 相加；雷射回饋與非線性自熱未納入算例。
knowledge.textEn: Pout=Pin×10^(-IL/10); ΔT≈PheatRth applies only to a linear steady thermal path. Fix power reference planes and add passive losses in dB; feedback and nonlinear self-heating are excluded.

quiz.question: 要審查「電流展布」，哪項主張或驗證方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or verification is justified when reviewing current spreading?
options: 接觸電阻及電流擁擠會造成局部溫升，平均電流密度不足以描述熱點。
封裝外殼溫度永遠等於接面溫度。
只見發光就能確認雷射閾值。
optionsEn: Contact resistance and current crowding create local heating; mean current density misses hot spots.
Case temperature always equals junction temperature.
Visible emission alone proves lasing threshold.
quiz.explanation: 接觸電阻及電流擁擠會造成局部溫升，平均電流密度不足以描述熱點。 將電壓降與熱像位置對照，區分光學吸收和接觸發熱。
quiz.explanationEn: Contact resistance and current crowding create local heating; mean current density misses hot spots. Correlate voltage drop with thermal position to distinguish absorption from contact heating.

steps.title: 電流展布：量測與判別
steps.objective: 以「電流展布」區分機制並作出有證據的驗收決定，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate mechanisms and make an evidence-based acceptance decision for current spreading, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，現在檢驗它是否足以解釋觀察。將電壓降與熱像位置對照，區分光學吸收和接觸發熱。 記錄原始量、單位、基準與重複量測差異；以支持及否定各一項證據比較「接觸電阻及電流擁擠會造成局部溫升，平均電流密度不足以描述熱點。」與錯誤假說「只見發光就能確認雷射閾值。」，最後提出放行、重測或修模決定。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Correlate voltage drop with thermal position to distinguish absorption from contact heating. Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "Contact resistance and current crowding create local heating; mean current density misses hot spots." against the incorrect hypothesis "Visible emission alone proves lasing threshold."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model.
steps.observation: 將電壓降與熱像位置對照，區分光學吸收和接觸發熱。
steps.observationEn: Correlate voltage drop with thermal position to distinguish absorption from contact heating.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：只見發光就能確認雷射閾值。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Visible emission alone proves lasing threshold. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交電流展布的量測判別表：將電壓降與熱像位置對照，區分光學吸收和接觸發熱。 附上基準、重複性或不確定度，及不能由本資料判定的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit a measurement-discrimination table for current spreading: Correlate voltage drop with thermal position to distinguish absorption from contact heating. Include the reference, repeatability or uncertainty, and conclusions the data cannot support.

summary: 從供體晶粒、印章轉移與異質光耦合拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate donor coupons, stamp transfer and heterogeneous optical coupling, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例

workedExample.textEn: Assume independent release, pickup, placement and connection probabilities of 0.98, 0.99, 0.97 and 0.99. Total yield is 0.9317, about 93.2%; 1,000 coupons give about 932 expected successes, not a guaranteed count.
workedExample.assumptions: 獨立良率模型不含同批污染、印章磨耗與空間相關性。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: The independent-yield model excludes batch contamination, stamp wear and spatial correlation.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

options: 光對準成功即可證明所有電接點成功。
總良率等於各步良率的算術平均。
預先量測減少把壞晶粒放到昂貴目標晶片的機會，但篩選覆蓋率不等於百分之百。
optionsEn: Optical alignment proves all electrical contacts are good.
Total yield is the arithmetic average of step yields.
Prescreening reduces placement of bad coupons on valuable targets, but test coverage is not perfect.
quiz.explanation: 預先量測減少把壞晶粒放到昂貴目標晶片的機會，但篩選覆蓋率不等於百分之百。 用混淆矩陣列真良品、漏失效、誤拒與未測晶粒。

knowledge.textEn: Pickup and release need different effective adhesion conditions; stamp deformation changes contact area and pose.

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與證據
knowledge.text: 比較印章接觸前後影像及目標位置，區分未拾取、未釋放與滑移。
knowledge.textEn: Compare pre/post-contact images and target coordinates to distinguish missed pickup, failed release and slip.

knowledge.title: 量化模型與適用邊界
knowledge.text: Ytotal=∏Yi；對位殘差須在共同坐標下計算。 獨立良率模型不含同批污染、印章磨耗與空間相關性。
knowledge.textEn: Ytotal=∏Yi; alignment residuals must use a common coordinate system. The independent-yield model excludes batch contamination, stamp wear and spatial correlation.

quiz.question: 要審查「印章黏附選擇」，哪項主張或驗證方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or verification is justified when reviewing stamp adhesion selection?
options: 總良率等於各步良率的算術平均。
比較印章接觸前後影像及目標位置，區分未拾取、未釋放與滑移。
光對準成功即可證明所有電接點成功。
optionsEn: Total yield is the arithmetic average of step yields.
Compare pre/post-contact images and target coordinates to distinguish missed pickup, failed release and slip.
Optical alignment proves all electrical contacts are good.
quiz.explanation: 拾取與放置需要不同有效黏附條件；印章變形會改變接觸面與姿態。 比較印章接觸前後影像及目標位置，區分未拾取、未釋放與滑移。
quiz.explanationEn: Pickup and release need different effective adhesion conditions; stamp deformation changes contact area and pose. Compare pre/post-contact images and target coordinates to distinguish missed pickup, failed release and slip.

steps.title: 錨點斷裂：模型與設計
steps.objective: 以「錨點斷裂」建立可檢驗的物理模型，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a falsifiable physical model for tether fracture, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先以師傅示意確認「錨點斷裂」的輸入、輸出與座標，再在學徒工作台完成對應元件或資料流的排列。錨點應在預期位置分離；碎片與晶粒裂紋是不同失效證據。 用本單元的變數畫出至少兩種設計狀態，說明它們在「對照源位和目標位的顯微圖，保留碎片位置而不只看目標有無晶粒。」的驗證中應有何差異；把待量測參數另列，不以動畫位置當成實際公差。
steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for tether fracture, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. Tethers should separate at intended sites; debris and coupon cracks are distinct failure evidence. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Compare donor and target micrographs, recording debris positions rather than only coupon presence. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances.
steps.observation: 對照源位和目標位的顯微圖，保留碎片位置而不只看目標有無晶粒。
steps.observationEn: Compare donor and target micrographs, recording debris positions rather than only coupon presence.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：光對準成功即可證明所有電接點成功。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Optical alignment proves all electrical contacts are good. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交錨點斷裂的兩狀態模型、變數表，以及能由「對照源位和目標位的顯微圖，保留碎片位置而不只看目標有無晶粒。」反駁模型的預測。
steps.checkEn: Submit two model states and a variable table for tether fracture, plus a falsifiable prediction using: Compare donor and target micrographs, recording debris positions rather than only coupon presence.

steps.title: 錨點斷裂：量測與判別

steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Compare donor and target micrographs, recording debris positions rather than only coupon presence. Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "Tethers should separate at intended sites; debris and coupon cracks are distinct failure evidence." against the incorrect hypothesis "Total yield is the arithmetic average of step yields."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model.

steps.check: 提交錨點斷裂的量測判別表：對照源位和目標位的顯微圖，保留碎片位置而不只看目標有無晶粒。 附上基準、重複性或不確定度，及不能由本資料判定的結論。

steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate mechanisms and make an evidence-based acceptance decision for traceability coding, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，現在檢驗它是否足以解釋觀察。建立供體位置、測試結果、印章批次和目標位置的關聯表並做一次反查。 記錄原始量、單位、基準與重複量測差異；以支持及否定各一項證據比較「源晶圓與目標晶片身分必須連結，才能將後續失效回溯供體批次。」與錯誤假說「單一最佳晶粒可以代表整片陣列良率。」，最後提出放行、重測或修模決定。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Link donor position, screening result, stamp batch and target position, then perform a reverse trace. Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "Donor and target identities must be linked to trace later failure to a donor lot." against the incorrect hypothesis "The best coupon represents full-array yield."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model.
steps.observation: 建立供體位置、測試結果、印章批次和目標位置的關聯表並做一次反查。
steps.observationEn: Link donor position, screening result, stamp batch and target position, then perform a reverse trace.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：單一最佳晶粒可以代表整片陣列良率。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: The best coupon represents full-array yield. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交追溯編碼的量測判別表：建立供體位置、測試結果、印章批次和目標位置的關聯表並做一次反查。 附上基準、重複性或不確定度，及不能由本資料判定的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit a measurement-discrimination table for traceability coding: Link donor position, screening result, stamp batch and target position, then perform a reverse trace. Include the reference, repeatability or uncertainty, and conclusions the data cannot support.

title: 矽上量子點雷射研究
summary: 從量子點增益、異質磊晶缺陷與長期穩定性拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate quantum-dot gain, heteroepitaxial defects and long-term stability, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設閾值電流 30 mA，注入面積 3 μm×1000 μm=3×10^-5 cm²，Jth=1000 A/cm²。若誤以 6 μm 寬換算，會得 500 A/cm²；差別來自定義，並非元件改進。
workedExample.textEn: Assume threshold current 30 mA and injection area 3 μm×1000 μm=3×10^-5 cm², giving Jth=1000 A/cm². Using 6 μm width instead gives 500 A/cm²; that difference is a definition error, not device improvement.
workedExample.assumptions: 算例不表示任何原始論文性能；面積定義與儀器校正需一致。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: The example does not represent any cited paper performance; area definition and calibration must be consistent.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units address Materials and gain through six separately saved modeling and verification work packages.

steps.title: 量子點與量子井：模型與設計
steps.titleEn: Dots versus wells: model and design
steps.objective: 以「量子點與量子井」建立可檢驗的物理模型，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a falsifiable physical model for dots versus wells, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先以師傅示意確認「量子點與量子井」的輸入、輸出與座標，再在學徒工作台完成對應元件或資料流的排列。三維載子侷限改變能態分布；量子點並不自動消除所有非輻射復合。 用本單元的變數畫出至少兩種設計狀態，說明它們在「比較能態示意和溫度相依發光，避免僅以名稱推定效率。」的驗證中應有何差異；把待量測參數另列，不以動畫位置當成實際公差。
steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for dots versus wells, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. Three-dimensional confinement changes the density of states; dots do not automatically remove nonradiative recombination. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Compare state diagrams and temperature-dependent emission rather than inferring efficiency from a label. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances.
steps.observation: 比較能態示意和溫度相依發光，避免僅以名稱推定效率。
steps.observationEn: Compare state diagrams and temperature-dependent emission rather than inferring efficiency from a label.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：量子點會消除所有位錯造成的復合。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Quantum dots eliminate all dislocation-related recombination. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交量子點與量子井的兩狀態模型、變數表，以及能由「比較能態示意和溫度相依發光，避免僅以名稱推定效率。」反駁模型的預測。
steps.checkEn: Submit two model states and a variable table for dots versus wells, plus a falsifiable prediction using: Compare state diagrams and temperature-dependent emission rather than inferring efficiency from a label.

options: 三維載子侷限改變能態分布；量子點並不自動消除所有非輻射復合。

Hold material batch and facet conditions fixed when comparing cavity lengths before interpreting loss trends. Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate gain compression, spontaneous emission and optoelectrothermal interfaces, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設輸入 0.1 mW、SOA 小訊號增益 15 dB、後段損失 3 dB，線性估計輸出=0.1×10^(12/10)=1.585 mW；若已達飽和，此估計須下修。
workedExample.textEn: Assume 0.1 mW input, 15 dB small-signal gain and 3 dB downstream loss. Linear output is 0.1×10^(12/10)=1.585 mW; saturation invalidates this extrapolation.
workedExample.assumptions: 未納入增益飽和、偏振及溫度變化；總光功率不等於訊號功率。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Saturation, polarization and temperature changes are excluded; total optical power is not signal power.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

載子恢復使增益具記憶性，長串連續符號可能引起圖樣相關失真。

Carrier recovery gives gain memory, allowing pattern-dependent distortion.

steps.title: 瞬態增益恢復：量測與判別
steps.titleEn: Transient gain recovery: measurement and diagnosis
steps.objective: 以「瞬態增益恢復」區分機制並作出有證據的驗收決定，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate mechanisms and make an evidence-based acceptance decision for transient gain recovery, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，現在檢驗它是否足以解釋觀察。比較相同平均功率但不同符號圖樣的眼圖與功率暫態。 記錄原始量、單位、基準與重複量測差異；以支持及否定各一項證據比較「載子恢復使增益具記憶性，長串連續符號可能引起圖樣相關失真。」與錯誤假說「補回功率就能完全補回 OSNR。」，最後提出放行、重測或修模決定。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Compare eye diagrams and power transients for patterns with equal mean power. Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "Carrier recovery gives gain memory, allowing pattern-dependent distortion." against the incorrect hypothesis "Restoring power fully restores OSNR."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model.
steps.observation: 比較相同平均功率但不同符號圖樣的眼圖與功率暫態。

steps.check: 提交瞬態增益恢復的量測判別表：比較相同平均功率但不同符號圖樣的眼圖與功率暫態。 附上基準、重複性或不確定度，及不能由本資料判定的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit a measurement-discrimination table for transient gain recovery: Compare eye diagrams and power transients for patterns with equal mean power. Include the reference, repeatability or uncertainty, and conclusions the data cannot support.

More current need not linearly increase net gain; heating shifts spectrum and saturation. title: 波分多工陣列波導光柵
summary: 從陣列光程差、成像與通道串擾拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate array path differences, imaging and channel crosstalk, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設 ng=4、相鄰臂長差 ΔL=50 μm，FSRν≈c/(ngΔL)=1.50 THz；在 λ=1550 nm 附近，FSRλ≈λ²/(ngΔL)=12.0 nm。 此算例以 c=3.00×10^8 m/s 作教學近似。
workedExample.textEn: Assume ng=4 and adjacent-arm increment ΔL=50 μm. FSRν≈c/(ngΔL)=1.50 THz; near λ=1550 nm, FSRλ≈λ²/(ngΔL)=12.0 nm. This example uses the teaching approximation c=3.00×10^8 m/s.
workedExample.assumptions: 小波長範圍近似且忽略高階色散；不代表任何量產 AWG 尺寸。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Local-wavelength approximation neglecting higher dispersion; not a production AWG dimension.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

steps.objectiveEn: Build a falsifiable physical model for waveguide-bend layout, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先以師傅示意確認「波導彎曲配置」的輸入、輸出與座標，再在學徒工作台完成對應元件或資料流的排列。相同幾何長度未必有相同相位，彎曲及截面會改變有效折射率。 用本單元的變數畫出至少兩種設計狀態，說明它們在「分開記錄直段、彎段長度與模態參數，做相位預算。」的驗證中應有何差異；把待量測參數另列，不以動畫位置當成實際公差。
steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for waveguide-bend layout, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. Equal geometric length need not mean equal phase; bends and cross sections affect effective index. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Budget straight and curved lengths with their separate modal parameters. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances.
steps.observation: 分開記錄直段、彎段長度與模態參數，做相位預算。
steps.observationEn: Budget straight and curved lengths with their separate modal parameters.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：光纖到光纖損失全部來自 AWG 核心。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: All fiber-to-fiber loss comes from the AWG core. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交波導彎曲配置的兩狀態模型、變數表，以及能由「分開記錄直段、彎段長度與模態參數，做相位預算。」反駁模型的預測。
steps.checkEn: Submit two model states and a variable table for waveguide-bend layout, plus a falsifiable prediction using: Budget straight and curved lengths with their separate modal parameters.

quiz.question: 要審查「波導彎曲配置」，哪項主張或驗證方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or verification is justified when reviewing waveguide-bend layout?
options: 光纖到光纖損失全部來自 AWG 核心。
所有臂加相同相位必定增加串擾。
相同幾何長度未必有相同相位，彎曲及截面會改變有效折射率。
optionsEn: All fiber-to-fiber loss comes from the AWG core.
An equal phase shift on every arm necessarily increases crosstalk.
Equal geometric length need not mean equal phase; bends and cross sections affect effective index.

quiz.explanationEn: Equal geometric length need not mean equal phase; bends and cross sections affect effective index. Budget straight and curved lengths with their separate modal parameters.

steps.title: 波導彎曲配置：量測與判別
steps.objective: 以「波導彎曲配置」區分機制並作出有證據的驗收決定，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。

steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，現在檢驗它是否足以解釋觀察。分開記錄直段、彎段長度與模態參數，做相位預算。 記錄原始量、單位、基準與重複量測差異；以支持及否定各一項證據比較「相同幾何長度未必有相同相位，彎曲及截面會改變有效折射率。」與錯誤假說「所有臂加相同相位必定增加串擾。」，最後提出放行、重測或修模決定。

Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "Equal geometric length need not mean equal phase; bends and cross sections affect effective index." against the incorrect hypothesis "An equal phase shift on every arm necessarily increases crosstalk."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model.

title: 微環波分多工濾波器
summary: 從環腔共振、通道格點與熱鎖定拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate ring resonances, channel grids and thermal locking, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. workedExample.textEn: Assume six switches at 0.4 dB each, four crossings at 0.05 dB each and 0.6 dB routing loss. Total loss is 3.2 dB; 1 mW input gives about 0.479 mW.
workedExample.assumptions: 假設被動損失、無相干反射與增益；數字是教學工作負載。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Assume passive loss without coherent reflections or gain; values describe a teaching workload.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。

stages.title: 校正與控制

steps.title: 監測埠配置：模型與設計

steps.instruction: 先以師傅示意確認「監測埠配置」的輸入、輸出與座標，再在學徒工作台完成對應元件或資料流的排列。監測點太少可能使多個錯誤狀態有相同輸出，造成不可觀測。 用本單元的變數畫出至少兩種設計狀態，說明它們在「畫每個可疑單元到監測埠的路徑，找出无法區分的一對故障。」的驗證中應有何差異；把待量測參數另列，不以動畫位置當成實際公差。
steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for monitor placement, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. Too few monitors can make distinct erroneous states produce identical outputs and become unobservable. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Trace suspect units to monitors and find an indistinguishable fault pair. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances.
steps.observation: 畫每個可疑單元到監測埠的路徑，找出无法區分的一對故障。

summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate tunable interferometers, matrix decomposition and closed-loop calibration, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設 8 級單元各有 0.25 dB 損失，總損失 2 dB，輸出功率比例 10^(-2/10)=0.631；因此理想酉矩陣的功率守恆不能直接用於此實體網格。
workedExample.textEn: Assume eight stages each lose 0.25 dB. Total loss is 2 dB and transmitted power fraction is 10^(-2/10)=0.631; ideal unitary power conservation cannot be directly assigned to this physical mesh.
workedExample.assumptions: 矩陣模型限於線性相干操作；非線性與動態熱記憶需擴充。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: The matrix model assumes linear coherent operation; nonlinearity and dynamic thermal memory require extensions.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

knowledge.textEn: Local calibration does not automatically compensate shared heat or phase conventions after cascading.

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與證據
knowledge.text: 比較逐單元預測與整體傳輸矩陣，定位系統性殘差。
knowledge.textEn: Compare unit predictions with the full transfer matrix to locate systematic residuals.

knowledge.title: 量化模型與適用邊界
knowledge.text: Eout=TEin；檢驗 T†T 是否接近所採無損模型，而非先假設等於 I。 矩陣模型限於線性相干操作；非線性與動態熱記憶需擴充。
knowledge.textEn: Eout=TEin; test whether T†T approaches the chosen lossless model rather than assuming I. The matrix model assumes linear coherent operation; nonlinearity and dynamic thermal memory require extensions.

quiz.question: 要審查「局部與全域校正」，哪項主張或驗證方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or verification is justified when reviewing local and global calibration?
options: 任何實體網格都完全無損且酉。
局部極值一定是全域最優。
局部單元校正無法自動補償串接後的共同熱擾動與相位規約。
optionsEn: Every physical mesh is lossless and unitary.
A local optimum is necessarily global.
Local calibration does not automatically compensate shared heat or phase conventions after cascading.
quiz.explanation: 局部單元校正無法自動補償串接後的共同熱擾動與相位規約。 比較逐單元預測與整體傳輸矩陣，定位系統性殘差。
quiz.explanationEn: Local calibration does not automatically compensate shared heat or phase conventions after cascading. Compare unit predictions with the full transfer matrix to locate systematic residuals.

steps.title: 局部與全域校正：量測與判別
steps.titleEn: Local and global calibration: measurement and diagnosis
steps.objective: 以「局部與全域校正」區分機制並作出有證據的驗收決定，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate mechanisms and make an evidence-based acceptance decision for local and global calibration, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，現在檢驗它是否足以解釋觀察。比較逐單元預測與整體傳輸矩陣，定位系統性殘差。 記錄原始量、單位、基準與重複量測差異；以支持及否定各一項證據比較「局部單元校正無法自動補償串接後的共同熱擾動與相位規約。」與錯誤假說「局部極值一定是全域最優。」，最後提出放行、重測或修模決定。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Compare unit predictions with the full transfer matrix to locate systematic residuals. Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "Local calibration does not automatically compensate shared heat or phase conventions after cascading." against the incorrect hypothesis "A local optimum is necessarily global."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model.
steps.observation: 比較逐單元預測與整體傳輸矩陣，定位系統性殘差。
steps.observationEn: Compare unit predictions with the full transfer matrix to locate systematic residuals.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：局部極值一定是全域最優。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: A local optimum is necessarily global. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交局部與全域校正的量測判別表：比較逐單元預測與整體傳輸矩陣，定位系統性殘差。 附上基準、重複性或不確定度，及不能由本資料判定的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit a measurement-discrimination table for local and global calibration: Compare unit predictions with the full transfer matrix to locate systematic residuals. Include the reference, repeatability or uncertainty, and conclusions the data cannot support.

A target operator may include nonunitary gain or attenuation and need not fit a lossless mesh. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Inspect target singular values and mark required attenuation or normalization. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances.

title: 相干光接收器整合
summary: 從光混頻、平衡偵測與光電共同設計拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate optical mixing, balanced detection and optoelectronic co-design, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設單一 50:50 平衡混頻器的入口功率（已扣除 I/Q 分支分光）為 Ps=0.01 mW、Plo=1 mW，響應度 R=0.8 A/W；差動拍頻峰值 i=2R√(PsPlo)=0.16 mA。Ps、Plo 並非整個 90° 混合器分光前的總功率。
workedExample.textEn: Assume inputs of one ideal 50:50 balanced mixer, after any I/Q branch splitting: Ps=0.01 mW, Plo=1 mW and responsivity R=0.8 A/W. Differential beat amplitude i=2R√(PsPlo)=0.16 mA. These are not total powers before a full 90-degree hybrid splits them.
workedExample.assumptions: 理想匹配、無飽和、未含散粒與 TIA 噪聲；非靈敏度保證。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Ideal matching without saturation, shot noise or TIA noise; not a sensitivity guarantee.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.
