steps.objective: 以「封裝測試角落」建立可檢驗的物理模型，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a falsifiable physical model for packaged test corners, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先以師傅示意確認「封裝測試角落」的輸入、輸出與座標，再在學徒工作台完成對應元件或資料流的排列。溫度、偏振、本振功率及電源共同決定最差接收狀態。 用本單元的變數畫出至少兩種設計狀態，說明它們在「選擇會同時壓縮動態範圍的角落並記錄失鎖與恢復。」的驗證中應有何差異；把待量測參數另列，不以動畫位置當成實際公差。
steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for packaged test corners, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. Temperature, polarization, LO power and supply jointly determine worst reception. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Choose corners that jointly squeeze dynamic range and record lock loss and recovery. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances.
steps.observation: 選擇會同時壓縮動態範圍的角落並記錄失鎖與恢復。
steps.observationEn: Choose corners that jointly squeeze dynamic range and record lock loss and recovery.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：平衡偵測會消除所有噪聲。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Balanced detection removes all noise. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交封裝測試角落的兩狀態模型、變數表，以及能由「選擇會同時壓縮動態範圍的角落並記錄失鎖與恢復。」反駁模型的預測。
steps.checkEn: Submit two model states and a variable table for packaged test corners, plus a falsifiable prediction using: Choose corners that jointly squeeze dynamic range and record lock loss and recovery.

knowledge.title: 本單元物理機制
knowledge.text: 溫度、偏振、本振功率及電源共同決定最差接收狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Temperature, polarization, LO power and supply jointly determine worst reception.

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與證據
knowledge.text: 選擇會同時壓縮動態範圍的角落並記錄失鎖與恢復。
knowledge.textEn: Choose corners that jointly squeeze dynamic range and record lock loss and recovery.

knowledge.title: 量化模型與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 拍頻項正比 √(PsPlo)，量測須明確指定混合器端口功率。 理想匹配、無飽和、未含散粒與 TIA 噪聲；非靈敏度保證。
knowledge.textEn: The beat term scales with √(PsPlo); explicitly define hybrid-port powers. Ideal matching without saturation, shot noise or TIA noise; not a sensitivity guarantee.

quiz.question: 要審查「封裝測試角落」，哪項主張或驗證方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or verification is justified when reviewing packaged test corners?
options: 本振功率越大永遠越好。
溫度、偏振、本振功率及電源共同決定最差接收狀態。
平衡偵測會消除所有噪聲。
optionsEn: More LO power is always better.
Temperature, polarization, LO power and supply jointly determine worst reception.
Balanced detection removes all noise.
quiz.explanation: 溫度、偏振、本振功率及電源共同決定最差接收狀態。 選擇會同時壓縮動態範圍的角落並記錄失鎖與恢復。
quiz.explanationEn: Temperature, polarization, LO power and supply jointly determine worst reception. Choose corners that jointly squeeze dynamic range and record lock loss and recovery.

steps.title: 封裝測試角落：量測與判別
steps.titleEn: Packaged test corners: measurement and diagnosis
steps.objective: 以「封裝測試角落」區分機制並作出有證據的驗收決定，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate mechanisms and make an evidence-based acceptance decision for packaged test corners, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，現在檢驗它是否足以解釋觀察。選擇會同時壓縮動態範圍的角落並記錄失鎖與恢復。 記錄原始量、單位、基準與重複量測差異；以支持及否定各一項證據比較「溫度、偏振、本振功率及電源共同決定最差接收狀態。」與錯誤假說「本振功率越大永遠越好。」，最後提出放行、重測或修模決定。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Choose corners that jointly squeeze dynamic range and record lock loss and recovery. Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "Temperature, polarization, LO power and supply jointly determine worst reception." against the incorrect hypothesis "More LO power is always better."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model.
steps.observation: 選擇會同時壓縮動態範圍的角落並記錄失鎖與恢復。
steps.observationEn: Choose corners that jointly squeeze dynamic range and record lock loss and recovery.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：本振功率越大永遠越好。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: More LO power is always better. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交封裝測試角落的量測判別表：選擇會同時壓縮動態範圍的角落並記錄失鎖與恢復。 附上基準、重複性或不確定度，及不能由本資料判定的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit a measurement-discrimination table for packaged test corners: Choose corners that jointly squeeze dynamic range and record lock loss and recovery. Include the reference, repeatability or uncertainty, and conclusions the data cannot support.

title: 光子相位陣列
summary: 從陣列相位、遠場旁瓣與封裝校正拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate array phase, far-field sidelobes and package calibration, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設均勻陣列 d=λ/2，欲偏轉 θ=30°，在所定符號下相鄰相位增量幅值 |Δφ|=2π(d/λ)sinθ=π/2；符號決定左右方向。
workedExample.textEn: Assume a uniform array with d=λ/2 and θ=30°. The adjacent phase-step magnitude is |Δφ|=2π(d/λ)sinθ=π/2; its sign sets left versus right under the chosen convention.
workedExample.assumptions: 均勻直線陣列、遠場、忽略互耦；不是眼安全或最大量距模型。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Uniform linear array in the far field, neglecting mutual coupling; not an eye-safety or maximum-range model.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

stages.title: 場與孔徑
stages.description: 以三個技術單元完成「場與孔徑」的模型與驗證，六項作業各自留存交付物。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units address Fields and aperture through six separately saved modeling and verification work packages.

steps.title: 陣列因子：模型與設計
steps.objective: 以「陣列因子」建立可檢驗的物理模型，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a falsifiable physical model for array factor, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先以師傅示意確認「陣列因子」的輸入、輸出與座標，再在學徒工作台完成對應元件或資料流的排列。遠場是各天線複數場相加，不能將強度直接相加來預測主瓣。 用本單元的變數畫出至少兩種設計狀態，說明它們在「比較兩天線同相與反相遠場，維持相同總輸入功率。」的驗證中應有何差異；把待量測參數另列，不以動畫位置當成實際公差。
steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for array factor, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. Far fields sum complex antenna fields, not intensities, to form the main lobe. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Compare in-phase and opposite-phase two-antenna far fields at equal input power. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances.
steps.observation: 比較兩天線同相與反相遠場，維持相同總輸入功率。
steps.observationEn: Compare in-phase and opposite-phase two-antenna far fields at equal input power.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：增天線數必定消除間距造成的光柵瓣。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Adding antennas always removes spacing-induced grating lobes. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交陣列因子的兩狀態模型、變數表，以及能由「比較兩天線同相與反相遠場，維持相同總輸入功率。」反駁模型的預測。
steps.checkEn: Submit two model states and a variable table for array factor, plus a falsifiable prediction using: Compare in-phase and opposite-phase two-antenna far fields at equal input power.

knowledge.title: 量化模型與適用邊界
knowledge.text: AF(θ)=Σan exp[i(nkd sinθ+φn)]；實際遠場另乘天線包絡。 均勻直線陣列、遠場、忽略互耦；不是眼安全或最大量距模型。
knowledge.textEn: AF(θ)=Σan exp[i(nkd sinθ+φn)]; actual far field also includes the element pattern. Uniform linear array in the far field, neglecting mutual coupling; not an eye-safety or maximum-range model.

quiz.question: 要審查「陣列因子」，哪項主張或驗證方法有根據？

title: FMCW 光達光子晶片
summary: 從線性啁啾、相干拍頻與距速分離拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate linear chirps, coherent beats and range-velocity separation, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設 B=10 GHz、T=100 μs，斜率 S=10^14 Hz/s；靜止目標 R=15 m，fb=2SR/c≈10 MHz。理想解析度 c/(2B)=15 mm；不含窗函數及雜訊。 此算例以 c=3.00×10^8 m/s 作教學近似。
workedExample.textEn: Assume B=10 GHz and T=100 μs, giving S=10^14 Hz/s. A static target at R=15 m gives fb≈10 MHz. Ideal resolution c/(2B)=15 mm, excluding window and noise effects. This example uses the teaching approximation c=3.00×10^8 m/s.
workedExample.assumptions: 線性啁啾、單一靜止目標及校正時間基準；此課僅虛擬光路。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Linear chirp, one static target and calibrated timing; only a virtual optical path is used.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

steps.title: 標定與時間基準：量測與判別

title: 矽光子生物感測器
summary: 從表面感測、參考通道與檢出限拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate surface sensing, reference channels and detection limits, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設濃度校正斜率 0.20 nm/(mg/L)，空白波長標準差 0.002 nm，以 3σ/slope 估計 LOD=0.030 mg/L。此為自訂統計示例，不是任何生物標記的診斷門檻。
workedExample.textEn: Assume calibration slope 0.20 nm/(mg/L) and blank wavelength SD 0.002 nm. A 3σ/slope estimate gives LOD=0.030 mg/L. This is a statistical teaching example, not a diagnostic cutoff for any biomarker.
workedExample.assumptions: 假設局部線性、穩定空白與指定噪聲統計；吸附飽和、基質效應不在算例內。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Assume local linearity, stable blanks and specified noise statistics; adsorption saturation and matrix effects are excluded.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

title: 中紅外積體光子感測
summary: 從中紅外材料透明窗、吸收路徑與背景校正拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate mid-IR transparency windows, absorption paths and background calibration, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設吸收係數 α=2 cm^-1、模態重疊 Γ=0.10、長度 L=1 cm，僅樣本吸收時 T=exp(-ΓαL)=exp(-0.2)=0.819；十進吸光度=-log10 T=0.0869。
workedExample.textEn: Assume α=2 cm^-1, modal overlap Γ=0.10 and length L=1 cm. With sample absorption alone T=exp(-ΓαL)=0.819; base-10 absorbance is -log10 T=0.0869.
workedExample.assumptions: 均勻濃度、弱耦合擾動與線性吸收；不代表某化學物質實測值。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Uniform concentration, weak modal perturbation and linear absorption; not measured values for a chemical.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

quiz.question: 要審查「氣體或液體傳輸」，哪項主張或驗證方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or verification is justified when reviewing gas or liquid transport?
options: 近紅外透明材料在所有中紅外波段也透明。
自然對數光學深度等於十進吸光度。

steps.title: 吸收與基線：模型與設計

steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for absorption and baseline, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. Source power, coupling and detector response vary with wavelength and require reference normalization. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Measure blank/sample spectra before forming ratios and retain dark-subtraction order. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances.
steps.observation: 量空白與樣本光譜後再求比值，保留暗訊號扣除順序。

summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate microresonator dispersion, nonlinear oscillation and comb coherence, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設環半徑 R=100 μm、ng=2，腔長 L=2πR=628.3 μm，FSR=c/(ngL)≈238.7 GHz。這只估線性模態間隔，不能由此聲稱已形成孤子。 此算例以 c=3.00×10^8 m/s 作教學近似。
workedExample.textEn: Assume ring radius R=100 μm and ng=2. Length L=628.3 μm gives FSR≈238.7 GHz. This estimates linear mode spacing and does not establish soliton formation. This example uses the teaching approximation c=3.00×10^8 m/s.

workedExample.assumptionsEn: Local constant-group-index approximation; pump, thermal and nonlinear thresholds are excluded.

steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate mechanisms and make an evidence-based acceptance decision for cavity enhancement, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，現在檢驗它是否足以解釋觀察。比較相同載入 Q、不同耦合比的入腔及輸出功率。 記錄原始量、單位、基準與重複量測差異；以支持及否定各一項證據比較「高 Q 增強腔內場，但耦合、泵浦失諧及熱穩定性共同決定可用增強。」與錯誤假說「矽與氮化矽的非線性和吸收完全相同。」，最後提出放行、重測或修模決定。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Compare intracavity and extracted powers for equal loaded Q but different coupling ratios. Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "High Q enhances intracavity fields, but coupling, detuning and thermal stability set usable enhancement." against the incorrect hypothesis "Silicon and silicon nitride have identical nonlinearity and absorption."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model.
steps.observation: 比較相同載入 Q、不同耦合比的入腔及輸出功率。
steps.observationEn: Compare intracavity and extracted powers for equal loaded Q but different coupling ratios.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：矽與氮化矽的非線性和吸收完全相同。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Silicon and silicon nitride have identical nonlinearity and absorption. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交腔增強的量測判別表：比較相同載入 Q、不同耦合比的入腔及輸出功率。 附上基準、重複性或不確定度，及不能由本資料判定的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit a measurement-discrimination table for cavity enhancement: Compare intracavity and extracted powers for equal loaded Q but different coupling ratios. Include the reference, repeatability or uncertainty, and conclusions the data cannot support.

knowledge.textEn: High Q enhances intracavity fields, but coupling, detuning and thermal stability set usable enhancement.

knowledge.text: 比較相同載入 Q、不同耦合比的入腔及輸出功率。
knowledge.textEn: Compare intracavity and extracted powers for equal loaded Q but different coupling ratios.

knowledge.title: 量化模型與適用邊界
knowledge.text: FSR≈c/(ngL)；Dint(μ)=ωμ−(ω0+D1μ) 需標明角頻率單位。 群折射率取常數的局部近似；泵浦、熱與非線性閾值不含於算例。
knowledge.textEn: FSR≈c/(ngL); Dint(μ)=ωμ−(ω0+D1μ) requires angular-frequency units. Local constant-group-index approximation; pump, thermal and nonlinear thresholds are excluded.

quiz.question: 要審查「腔增強」，哪項主張或驗證方法有根據？

quiz.question: 要審查「光譜關聯」，哪項主張或驗證方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or verification is justified when reviewing spectral correlations?
options: 只看明亮光譜就能證明量子光。
提高泵浦只增加好處而不增加多對事件。
訊號與閒置光子的聯合光譜關聯影響 heralded 純度；窄單臂光譜不足以證明純度。
optionsEn: A bright spectrum alone proves quantum light.
Higher pump adds benefits without increasing multipair events.
Joint spectral correlations affect heralded purity; a narrow single-arm spectrum does not prove purity.
quiz.explanation: 訊號與閒置光子的聯合光譜關聯影響 heralded 純度；窄單臂光譜不足以證明純度。 畫聯合光譜而非兩條各自光譜，標出儀器解析度及相位資訊缺口。
quiz.explanationEn: Joint spectral correlations affect heralded purity; a narrow single-arm spectrum does not prove purity. Plot a joint spectrum rather than two separate spectra, marking resolution and missing phase information.

steps.title: 光譜關聯：量測與判別

Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "Joint spectral correlations affect heralded purity; a narrow single-arm spectrum does not prove purity." against the incorrect hypothesis "Higher pump adds benefits without increasing multipair events."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model.

summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate wafer position, coupling de-embedding and measurement statistics, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設同型耦合器的 1 cm 與 3 cm 波導總損耗分別為 5.2 與 6.0 dB：α=(6.0−5.2)/(3−1)=0.40 dB/cm；共同截距=4.8 dB。若兩次獨立量測的標準不確定度各 0.10 dB，u(α)=√2×0.10/2=0.071 dB/cm，未含長度或耦合器變異。
workedExample.textEn: Assume matched-coupler waveguides of 1 and 3 cm have 5.2 and 6.0 dB total loss. α=(6.0−5.2)/(3−1)=0.40 dB/cm and intercept=4.8 dB. Two independent 0.10 dB standard uncertainties give u(α)=0.071 dB/cm, excluding length and coupler variation.
workedExample.assumptions: 假設同波長、同偏振、同耦合器及線性長度模型；真實製程需多長度及重複樣本。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Assume matched wavelength, polarization and couplers with linear length dependence; real processes need multiple lengths and repeats.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

title: 光子封裝熱機耦合分析
summary: 從熱場、翹曲、界面和光模式的耦合拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate coupled temperature fields, warpage, interfaces and optical modes, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設兩材料 CTE 差 Δα=12×10⁻⁶/K、長度 L=10 mm、溫差 ΔT=50 K，自由失配位移 Δu=ΔαLΔT=6 µm。這不是實際封裝位移或應力；機械拘束、翹曲與材料溫度依賴尚未加入。
workedExample.textEn: Assume Δα=12×10⁻⁶/K, L=10 mm and ΔT=50 K. Free mismatch Δu=ΔαLΔT=6 µm. This is not actual package displacement or stress; constraints, curvature and temperature-dependent properties are omitted.
workedExample.assumptions: 小變形、局部線性近似；不同晶向、塑性與黏彈歷史需另建模型。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Small-deformation/local-linear approximation; crystal orientation, plasticity and viscoelastic history need separate models.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

knowledge.textEn: Deformation can displace a fiber core relative to a waveguide despite little bulk motion.

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與證據
knowledge.text: 輸出相對位移而非全域位移，與耦合損失曲面對照。
knowledge.textEn: Extract relative rather than global displacement and compare with a coupling-loss surface.

knowledge.title: 量化模型與適用邊界
knowledge.text: Δu≈ΔαLΔT；光相位 Δφ=(2π/λ)Δ(neffL)，須區分材料與幾何項。 小變形、局部線性近似；不同晶向、塑性與黏彈歷史需另建模型。
knowledge.textEn: Δu≈ΔαLΔT; optical phase Δφ=(2π/λ)Δ(neffL) separates material and geometric terms. Small-deformation/local-linear approximation; crystal orientation, plasticity and viscoelastic history need separate models.

quiz.question: 要審查「光纖位移」，哪項主張或驗證方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or verification is justified when reviewing fiber displacement?
options: 自由膨脹位移就等於受拘束封裝應力。
封裝形變可讓纖芯與波導相對位移，即使兩者整體移動很小。
光相位只與元件幾何移動有關。
optionsEn: Free expansion equals constrained-package stress.
Deformation can displace a fiber core relative to a waveguide despite little bulk motion.
Optical phase depends only on geometric motion.
quiz.explanation: 封裝形變可讓纖芯與波導相對位移，即使兩者整體移動很小。 輸出相對位移而非全域位移，與耦合損失曲面對照。
quiz.explanationEn: Deformation can displace a fiber core relative to a waveguide despite little bulk motion. Extract relative rather than global displacement and compare with a coupling-loss surface.

steps.title: 光纖位移：量測與判別
steps.objective: 以「光纖位移」區分機制並作出有證據的驗收決定，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate mechanisms and make an evidence-based acceptance decision for fiber displacement, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，現在檢驗它是否足以解釋觀察。輸出相對位移而非全域位移，與耦合損失曲面對照。 記錄原始量、單位、基準與重複量測差異；以支持及否定各一項證據比較「封裝形變可讓纖芯與波導相對位移，即使兩者整體移動很小。」與錯誤假說「自由膨脹位移就等於受拘束封裝應力。」，最後提出放行、重測或修模決定。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Extract relative rather than global displacement and compare with a coupling-loss surface. Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "Deformation can displace a fiber core relative to a waveguide despite little bulk motion." against the incorrect hypothesis "Free expansion equals constrained-package stress."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model.
steps.observation: 輸出相對位移而非全域位移，與耦合損失曲面對照。
steps.observationEn: Extract relative rather than global displacement and compare with a coupling-loss surface.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：自由膨脹位移就等於受拘束封裝應力。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Free expansion equals constrained-package stress. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交光纖位移的量測判別表：輸出相對位移而非全域位移，與耦合損失曲面對照。 附上基準、重複性或不確定度，及不能由本資料判定的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit a measurement-discrimination table for fiber displacement: Extract relative rather than global displacement and compare with a coupling-loss surface. Include the reference, repeatability or uncertainty, and conclusions the data cannot support.

stages.title: 光相位與數值收斂
stages.description: 以三個技術單元檢查「光相位與數值收斂」，每一單元交付設計模型及獨立判別證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units examine optical phase and numerical convergence, each delivering a model and independent diagnostic evidence.

steps.title: 光彈與幾何：模型與設計
steps.titleEn: Photoelasticity and geometry: model and design
steps.objective: 以「光彈與幾何」建立可檢驗的物理模型，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a falsifiable physical model for photoelasticity and geometry, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先以師傅示意確認「光彈與幾何」的輸入、輸出與座標，再在學徒工作台完成對應元件或資料流的排列。相位包含光程長度與折射率變化，僅追蹤位移會漏掉光彈項。 用本單元的變數畫出至少兩種設計狀態，說明它們在「分別關閉幾何及材料項作敏感度比較，避免重複計入。」的驗證中應有何差異；把待量測參數另列，不以動畫位置當成實際公差。
steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for photoelasticity and geometry, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. Phase includes path length and index changes; displacement alone omits photoelasticity. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Toggle geometric and material terms separately in sensitivity analysis to avoid double counting. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances.
steps.observation: 分別關閉幾何及材料項作敏感度比較，避免重複計入。
steps.observationEn: Toggle geometric and material terms separately in sensitivity analysis to avoid double counting.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：自由膨脹位移就等於受拘束封裝應力。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Free expansion equals constrained-package stress. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交光彈與幾何的兩狀態模型、變數表，以及能由「分別關閉幾何及材料項作敏感度比較，避免重複計入。」反駁模型的預測。

title: 光路溫度漂移補償
summary: 從漂移量測、熱串擾與穩定回授拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate drift sensing, thermal crosstalk and stable feedback, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設共振溫度斜率 80 pm/K，環境變化 3 K 產生 240 pm 漂移；假設加熱器斜率 40 pm/mW，要反向補償 240 pm 需相對原偏壓減少 6 mW。若原偏壓僅 4 mW，單純加熱器無法完成此負向補償。
workedExample.textEn: Assume 80 pm/K resonance drift and a 3 K change: 240 pm. With 40 pm/mW heater slope, opposing this shift requires reducing bias by 6 mW. A 4 mW initial bias cannot supply that negative correction.
workedExample.assumptions: 局部線性且固定偏振；這組斜率是假想值，沒有代表特定製程。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Local linearity and fixed polarization; slopes are hypothetical, not a process specification.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

title: 光子封裝失效重路由
summary: 從N−1 連通、光功率裕度與恢復狀態機拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate N−1 connectivity, optical power margins and restoration state machines, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假想網路兩條路徑 S-A-T 的損耗為 1+1=2 dB；S-B-C-T 為 1.5+1.5+1.5=4.5 dB。若發射 0 dBm、接收門檻 −6 dBm，正常裕度 4 dB、備援裕度 1.5 dB；要求保留 2 dB 時備援雖連通仍不合格。移除共用 S 或 T 則兩路均失效，不能宣稱全節點 N−1。另作容量檢驗：假設兩條互不共用瓶頸的路徑各100 Gb/s，正常共200 Gb/s；失去一條後剩100 Gb/s，若最低服務需150 Gb/s，仍有連通也不合格。
workedExample.textEn: Hypothetical routes S-A-T lose 2 dB and S-B-C-T lose 4.5 dB. With 0 dBm launch and −6 dBm receiver threshold, margins are 4 and 1.5 dB. A 2 dB reserve rejects the connected backup. Removing shared S or T disables both, so full node-N−1 is not achieved. For a separate capacity check, two paths with no shared bottleneck at 100 Gb/s each provide 200 Gb/s normally and 100 Gb/s after either fails; a 150 Gb/s minimum fails despite connectivity.
workedExample.assumptions: 理想無增益線性路由；門檻與損失為教學假設，未包含非線性、相干串音與 FEC。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Ideal linear routes without gain; assumed thresholds/losses exclude nonlinear effects, coherent crosstalk and FEC.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

For a separate capacity check, two paths with no shared bottleneck at 100 Gb/s each provide 200 Gb/s normally and 100 Gb/s after either fails; a 150 Gb/s minimum fails despite connectivity.

title: 封裝應力對光學相位的影響
summary: 從晶向、應變張量、模態重疊與光程拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate crystal axes, strain tensors, modal overlap and optical path, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設 λ=1.55 µm、L=1 mm、neff=2.4、Δneff=1×10⁻⁵、軸向應變 ε=10 µstrain=10⁻⁵，則 ΔL=10 nm；材料項 Δφn=0.0405 rad，長度項 ΔφL=0.0973 rad，总計 0.1378 rad。Δneff 是假設的有效模態變化，不是引用矽的固定塊材係數。
workedExample.textEn: Assume λ=1.55 µm, L=1 mm, neff=2.4, Δneff=10⁻⁵ and axial strain ε=10 µstrain=10⁻⁵, giving ΔL=10 nm. The index term is 0.0405 rad and length term 0.0973 rad, totaling 0.1378 rad. Δneff is an assumed modal change, not a fixed bulk-silicon coefficient.
workedExample.assumptions: 小擾動且真空波長固定；張量、偏振、材料色散和幾何重算需在完整模型中處理。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Small perturbations at fixed vacuum wavelength; full models treat tensors, polarization, dispersion and deformed geometry.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

title: 光子晶片製程設計套件
summary: 從PDK 版本、設計規則、模型角落與封裝交接拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate PDK versions, design rules, model corners and assembly handoff, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設路徑有兩耦合器各 1.5 dB、四分光器各 0.2 dB 超額損失及 2 cm 波導 α=0.5 dB/cm，總額外損失=3+0.8+1=4.8 dB。若波導角落 α=0.8，其他固定，為 5.4 dB；6 dB 額外損耗預算的裕度由 1.2 變成 0.6 dB。理想分光到特定支路的功率分配損失須另加，不能漏算。
workedExample.textEn: Assume two 1.5 dB couplers, four 0.2 dB splitter excess losses and 2 cm at 0.5 dB/cm: extra loss is 4.8 dB. At 0.8 dB/cm it becomes 5.4 dB, reducing a 6 dB excess-loss budget margin from 1.2 to 0.6 dB. Ideal splitting to the selected branch must be added separately.
workedExample.assumptions: 假想元件庫和損失，非任一 PDK 規格；不分發受限制 PDK。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Hypothetical library/losses, not a PDK specification; restricted PDKs are not redistributed.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

steps.instruction: 先以師傅示意確認「平台與版本」的輸入、輸出與座標，再在學徒工作台完成對應元件或資料流的排列。同一名稱的 PDK 更新可能更改圖層、模型及規則；版本是設計資料的一部分。 用本單元的變數畫出至少兩種設計狀態，說明它們在「建立工具、PDK、模型與版圖雜湊清單，禁止混用不同發布包。」的驗證中應有何差異；把待量測參數另列，不以動畫位置當成實際公差。
steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for platform and revision, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. PDK revisions can change layers, models and rules; revision belongs to design identity. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Record tool/PDK/model/layout hashes and prevent mixed releases. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances.
steps.observation: 建立工具、PDK、模型與版圖雜湊清單，禁止混用不同發布包。
steps.observationEn: Record tool/PDK/model/layout hashes and prevent mixed releases.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：DRC 通過就保證光學功能合格。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。

steps.check: 提交平台與版本的兩狀態模型、變數表，以及能由「建立工具、PDK、模型與版圖雜湊清單，禁止混用不同發布包。」反駁模型的預測。

steps.title: 平台與版本：量測與判別

steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，現在檢驗它是否足以解釋觀察。建立工具、PDK、模型與版圖雜湊清單，禁止混用不同發布包。 記錄原始量、單位、基準與重複量測差異；以支持及否定各一項證據比較「同一名稱的 PDK 更新可能更改圖層、模型及規則；版本是設計資料的一部分。」與錯誤假說「圖層顏色相同就能跨平台直接製造。」，最後提出放行、重測或修模決定。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Record tool/PDK/model/layout hashes and prevent mixed releases. Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "PDK revisions can change layers, models and rules; revision belongs to design identity." against the incorrect hypothesis "Matching layer colors permits fabrication on any platform."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model.

steps.check: 提交平台與版本的量測判別表：建立工具、PDK、模型與版圖雜湊清單，禁止混用不同發布包。 附上基準、重複性或不確定度，及不能由本資料判定的結論。

steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for parameterized cells, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. PCell validity bounds govern model use; arbitrary stretching need not remain characterized. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances. Assume two 1.5 dB couplers, four 0.2 dB splitter excess losses and 2 cm at 0.5 dB/cm: extra loss is 4.8 dB. At 0.8 dB/cm it becomes 5.4 dB, reducing a 6 dB excess-loss budget margin from 1.2 to 0.6 dB. Ideal splitting to the selected branch must be added separately.

subcategoryTitleEn: Photonic test, drift and design verification

title: 共封裝光學交換器整合
summary: 從交換 ASIC、光引擎、雷射與散熱的共同介面拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate joint switch-ASIC, optical-engine, laser and cooling interfaces, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假想系統有 ASIC 600 W、8 個光引擎每個 15 W、外接雷射 40 W、控制 10 W，系統合計 770 W。若8個引擎每個單向 1.6 Tb/s，單向總量 12.8 Tb/s；770/12.8×10¹²=60.2 pJ/bit 是此系統邊界的平均能量，不能稱為光子晶片本身能效。
workedExample.textEn: A hypothetical system has a 600 W ASIC, eight 15 W engines, 40 W external lasers and 10 W control: 770 W. Eight 1.6 Tb/s one-way engines total 12.8 Tb/s. 770/(12.8×10¹²)=60.2 pJ/bit is system-boundary energy, not intrinsic photonic-chip efficiency.
workedExample.assumptions: 固定滿載、未加備援與冷卻設施功耗；教學數字不代表任何商用 CPO。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Fixed full load excludes spare capacity and facility cooling; values do not describe a commercial CPO product.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

knowledge.textEn: Psystem=ΣPi; Ebit=Psystem/Ruseful requires matched power and bandwidth boundaries. Fixed full load excludes spare capacity and facility cooling; values do not describe a commercial CPO product.

quiz.question: 要審查「熱預算」，哪項主張或驗證方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or verification is justified when reviewing thermal budget?
options: 光引擎受 ASIC 熱耦合與自身功耗影響，散熱器平均溫度不代表光子熱點。
雙向總量可以直接當單向有效容量。
光引擎靠近 ASIC 就不再需要熱設計。
optionsEn: Optics experience ASIC coupling and self-heating; mean sink temperature misses photonic hotspots.
Bidirectional aggregate equals one-way useful capacity.
Optics near an ASIC no longer need thermal design.
quiz.explanation: 光引擎受 ASIC 熱耦合與自身功耗影響，散熱器平均溫度不代表光子熱點。 按算例建立功率及每路徑熱阻，检查局部温度與光漂移。
quiz.explanationEn: Optics experience ASIC coupling and self-heating; mean sink temperature misses photonic hotspots. Build power and path-resistance budgets from the example and check local temperature/drift.

steps.title: 熱預算：量測與判別
steps.objective: 以「熱預算」區分機制並作出有證據的驗收決定，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate mechanisms and make an evidence-based acceptance decision for thermal budget, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，現在檢驗它是否足以解釋觀察。按算例建立功率及每路徑熱阻，检查局部温度與光漂移。 記錄原始量、單位、基準與重複量測差異；以支持及否定各一項證據比較「光引擎受 ASIC 熱耦合與自身功耗影響，散熱器平均溫度不代表光子熱點。」與錯誤假說「光引擎靠近 ASIC 就不再需要熱設計。」，最後提出放行、重測或修模決定。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Build power and path-resistance budgets from the example and check local temperature/drift. Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "Optics experience ASIC coupling and self-heating; mean sink temperature misses photonic hotspots." against the incorrect hypothesis "Optics near an ASIC no longer need thermal design."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model.
steps.observation: 按算例建立功率及每路徑熱阻，检查局部温度與光漂移。
steps.observationEn: Build power and path-resistance budgets from the example and check local temperature/drift.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：光引擎靠近 ASIC 就不再需要熱設計。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Optics near an ASIC no longer need thermal design. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交熱預算的量測判別表：按算例建立功率及每路徑熱阻，检查局部温度與光漂移。 附上基準、重複性或不確定度，及不能由本資料判定的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit a measurement-discrimination table for thermal budget: Build power and path-resistance budgets from the example and check local temperature/drift. Include the reference, repeatability or uncertainty, and conclusions the data cannot support.

stages.title: 功耗與共同測試
stages.description: 以三個技術單元檢查「功耗與共同測試」，每一單元交付設計模型及獨立判別證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units examine power and joint testing, each delivering a model and independent diagnostic evidence.

steps.title: 供電與去耦：模型與設計
steps.titleEn: Power and decoupling: model and design
steps.objective: 以「供電與去耦」建立可檢驗的物理模型，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a falsifiable physical model for power and decoupling, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先以師傅示意確認「供電與去耦」的輸入、輸出與座標，再在學徒工作台完成對應元件或資料流的排列。ASIC 負載瞬變會透過共用供電干擾驅動器、TIA 或雷射。 用本單元的變數畫出至少兩種設計狀態，說明它們在「將供電阻抗和光接收誤碼的時間相關性對照。」的驗證中應有何差異；把待量測參數另列，不以動畫位置當成實際公差。
steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for power and decoupling, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. ASIC transients can disturb drivers, TIAs or lasers through shared power. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Correlate power impedance/transients with optical bit errors. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances.
steps.observation: 將供電阻抗和光接收誤碼的時間相關性對照。
steps.observationEn: Correlate power impedance/transients with optical bit errors.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：雙向總量可以直接當單向有效容量。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Bidirectional aggregate equals one-way useful capacity. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交供電與去耦的兩狀態模型、變數表，以及能由「將供電阻抗和光接收誤碼的時間相關性對照。」反駁模型的預測。
steps.checkEn: Submit two model states and a variable table for power and decoupling, plus a falsifiable prediction using: Correlate power impedance/transients with optical bit errors.

knowledge.title: 本單元物理機制
knowledge.text: ASIC 負載瞬變會透過共用供電干擾驅動器、TIA 或雷射。
knowledge.textEn: ASIC transients can disturb drivers, TIAs or lasers through shared power.

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與證據
knowledge.text: 將供電阻抗和光接收誤碼的時間相關性對照。
knowledge.textEn: Correlate power impedance/transients with optical bit errors.

knowledge.title: 量化模型與適用邊界
knowledge.text: Psystem=ΣPi；Ebit=Psystem/Ruseful，頻寬與功耗的邊界必須相同。 固定滿載、未加備援與冷卻設施功耗；教學數字不代表任何商用 CPO。
knowledge.textEn: Psystem=ΣPi; Ebit=Psystem/Ruseful requires matched power and bandwidth boundaries. Fixed full load excludes spare capacity and facility cooling; values do not describe a commercial CPO product.

quiz.question: 要審查「供電與去耦」，哪項主張或驗證方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or verification is justified when reviewing power and decoupling?
options: ASIC 負載瞬變會透過共用供電干擾驅動器、TIA 或雷射。
雙向總量可以直接當單向有效容量。
光引擎靠近 ASIC 就不再需要熱設計。
optionsEn: ASIC transients can disturb drivers, TIAs or lasers through shared power.
Bidirectional aggregate equals one-way useful capacity.
Optics near an ASIC no longer need thermal design.
quiz.explanation: ASIC 負載瞬變會透過共用供電干擾驅動器、TIA 或雷射。 將供電阻抗和光接收誤碼的時間相關性對照。
quiz.explanationEn: ASIC transients can disturb drivers, TIAs or lasers through shared power. Correlate power impedance/transients with optical bit errors.

steps.title: 供電與去耦：量測與判別
steps.titleEn: Power and decoupling: measurement and diagnosis
steps.objective: 以「供電與去耦」區分機制並作出有證據的驗收決定，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate mechanisms and make an evidence-based acceptance decision for power and decoupling, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，現在檢驗它是否足以解釋觀察。將供電阻抗和光接收誤碼的時間相關性對照。 記錄原始量、單位、基準與重複量測差異；以支持及否定各一項證據比較「ASIC 負載瞬變會透過共用供電干擾驅動器、TIA 或雷射。」與錯誤假說「光引擎靠近 ASIC 就不再需要熱設計。」，最後提出放行、重測或修模決定。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Correlate power impedance/transients with optical bit errors. Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "ASIC transients can disturb drivers, TIAs or lasers through shared power." against the incorrect hypothesis "Optics near an ASIC no longer need thermal design."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model.
steps.observation: 將供電阻抗和光接收誤碼的時間相關性對照。
steps.observationEn: Correlate power impedance/transients with optical bit errors.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：光引擎靠近 ASIC 就不再需要熱設計。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Optics near an ASIC no longer need thermal design. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交供電與去耦的量測判別表：將供電阻抗和光接收誤碼的時間相關性對照。 附上基準、重複性或不確定度，及不能由本資料判定的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit a measurement-discrimination table for power and decoupling: Correlate power impedance/transients with optical bit errors. Include the reference, repeatability or uncertainty, and conclusions the data cannot support.

quiz.question: 要審查「系統驗收」，哪項主張或驗證方法有根據？

Power, bandwidth, BER, temperature and recovery need matched loads.

steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，現在檢驗它是否足以解釋觀察。以完整流量與熱穩態測試矩陣交付，保留未測的角落。 記錄原始量、單位、基準與重複量測差異；以支持及否定各一項證據比較「功耗、頻寬、BER、溫度與故障恢復應在同一負載條件下衡量。」與錯誤假說「雙向總量可以直接當單向有效容量。」，最後提出放行、重測或修模決定。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Deliver a full-traffic thermal-state test matrix and explicit untested corners. Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "Power, bandwidth, BER, temperature and recovery need matched loads." against the incorrect hypothesis "Bidirectional aggregate equals one-way useful capacity."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model.

steps.checkEn: Submit a measurement-discrimination table for system acceptance: Deliver a full-traffic thermal-state test matrix and explicit untested corners. Include the reference, repeatability or uncertainty, and conclusions the data cannot support.

title: 光學輸入輸出小晶片
summary: 從通道、光波長、能量及端到端可用容量拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate lanes, optical wavelengths, energy and end-to-end usable capacity, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設每方向 64 通道、每通道 32 Gb/s，則單向=2.048 Tb/s，雙向合計=4.096 Tb/s。若有效負載比例 0.90，單向有效=1.8432 Tb/s。另假設完整光 I/O 功耗 10 W，按單向有效容量計為 5.43 pJ/bit；若改用雙向分母，必須也定義同時雙向負載。
workedExample.textEn: Assume 64 lanes per direction at 32 Gb/s: 2.048 Tb/s one way and 4.096 Tb/s aggregate. At 90% payload, one-way useful capacity is 1.8432 Tb/s. A hypothetical 10 W complete optical-I/O budget gives 5.43 pJ/bit on that denominator; bidirectional accounting must specify simultaneous traffic.
workedExample.assumptions: 通道參數是教學設計，並非複製某晶片所有規格；BER 近似假設獨立稀少錯誤。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Lane inputs are educational, not a complete device specification; BER approximation assumes rare independent errors.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

steps.title: 單向與雙向：模型與設計

steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for direction accounting, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. List capacities per direction; their sum is a particular aggregate convention. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Recalculate lanes times rate and retain coding/FEC overhead. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances.

steps.check: 提交單向與雙向的兩狀態模型、變數表，以及能由「依算例由通道數乘資料率重算，保留編碼及 FEC 開銷。」反駁模型的預測。

title: 光子與電子晶片共同設計
summary: 從驅動器、調變器、光偵測器和 TIA 的共同負載拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate joint driver, modulator, photodetector and TIA loading, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設 lumped 驅動器 R=50 Ω、PIC及封裝總電容 C=100 fF，fRC=1/(2πRC)=31.8 GHz。若接點再加 50 fF，變成 21.2 GHz。這只是一階電 RC，不代表完整電光 3 dB 頻寬；電極分布、光子壽命和接收器尚未加入。
workedExample.textEn: Assume a lumped 50 Ω driver and 100 fF total load: fRC=31.8 GHz. Another 50 fF lowers it to 21.2 GHz. This is only a first-order electrical RC limit, not complete electro-optic bandwidth; electrode distribution, photon lifetime and receiver are excluded.
workedExample.assumptions: 小訊號線性模型、固定偏壓與端接；需用非線性時域資料驗證大訊號。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Small-signal linear model at fixed bias/termination; large signals need nonlinear time-domain validation.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

stages.description: 以三個技術單元檢查「參考面與頻寬」，每一單元交付設計模型及獨立判別證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units examine reference planes and bandwidth, each delivering a model and independent diagnostic evidence.

steps.title: 介面參考面：模型與設計
steps.titleEn: Interface reference planes: model and design
steps.objective: 以「介面參考面」建立可檢驗的物理模型，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a falsifiable physical model for interface reference planes, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先以師傅示意確認「介面參考面」的輸入、輸出與座標，再在學徒工作台完成對應元件或資料流的排列。EIC 的輸出端和 PIC 電極入口之間含封裝寄生，不能直接把兩條理想曲線相接。 用本單元的變數畫出至少兩種設計狀態，說明它們在「定義電光共同參考面及量測去嵌入檔，核對阻抗。」的驗證中應有何差異；把待量測參數另列，不以動畫位置當成實際公差。
steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for interface reference planes, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. Package parasitics sit between the EIC output and PIC electrode; ideal standalone curves cannot simply be concatenated. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Define shared reference planes/de-embedding and audit impedances. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances.
steps.observation: 定義電光共同參考面及量測去嵌入檔，核對阻抗。
steps.observationEn: Define shared reference planes/de-embedding and audit impedances.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：總鏈路頻寬永遠等於最慢元件的標稱頻寬。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Total link bandwidth always equals the slowest rated component. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交介面參考面的兩狀態模型、變數表，以及能由「定義電光共同參考面及量測去嵌入檔，核對阻抗。」反駁模型的預測。
steps.checkEn: Submit two model states and a variable table for interface reference planes, plus a falsifiable prediction using: Define shared reference planes/de-embedding and audit impedances.

quiz.question: 要審查「介面參考面」，哪項主張或驗證方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or verification is justified when reviewing interface reference planes?
options: EIC 的輸出端和 PIC 電極入口之間含封裝寄生，不能直接把兩條理想曲線相接。
總鏈路頻寬永遠等於最慢元件的標稱頻寬。
光輸出會讓電返回路徑不再重要。
optionsEn: Package parasitics sit between the EIC output and PIC electrode; ideal standalone curves cannot simply be concatenated.
Total link bandwidth always equals the slowest rated component.
An optical output removes the need for electrical return paths.
quiz.explanation: EIC 的輸出端和 PIC 電極入口之間含封裝寄生，不能直接把兩條理想曲線相接。 定義電光共同參考面及量測去嵌入檔，核對阻抗。

steps.title: 介面參考面：量測與判別
steps.titleEn: Interface reference planes: measurement and diagnosis
steps.objective: 以「介面參考面」區分機制並作出有證據的驗收決定，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。

steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Define shared reference planes/de-embedding and audit impedances. Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "Package parasitics sit between the EIC output and PIC electrode; ideal standalone curves cannot simply be concatenated." against the incorrect hypothesis "An optical output removes the need for electrical return paths."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model.

steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: An optical output removes the need for electrical return paths. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交介面參考面的量測判別表：定義電光共同參考面及量測去嵌入檔，核對阻抗。 附上基準、重複性或不確定度，及不能由本資料判定的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit a measurement-discrimination table for interface reference planes: Define shared reference planes/de-embedding and audit impedances. Include the reference, repeatability or uncertainty, and conclusions the data cannot support.

title: 高速光模組電磁相容性
titleEn: Electromagnetic compatibility of high-speed optical modules
summary: 從發射源、耦合路徑、接收端與可重現測試拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate emission sources, coupling paths, victims and reproducible tests, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 教學接收電壓 100 µV 對 1 µV 基準為 20log10(100)=40 dBµV；降到 20 µV 為 26.02 dBµV，降低 13.98 dB。若纜線損失 2 dB 且需回推源端，應加 2 dB。這些數字不是任何標準的合格限值。
workedExample.textEn: A teaching receiver voltage of 100 µV is 40 dBµV; 20 µV is 26.02 dBµV, a 13.98 dB reduction. Add a 2 dB cable loss when referring back to the source. These are not acceptance limits from a standard.
workedExample.assumptions: 假設同一量測阻抗、檢波器與帶寬；正式測試依適用標準和校正配置。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Assume matched impedance, detector and bandwidth; formal testing follows applicable standards and calibrated setup.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

title: 光收發器雷射安全與互鎖
summary: 從設備分類、可接近發射與故障安全狀態拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate equipment classification, accessible emission and fail-safe states, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 非發光邏輯教學假設：偵測延遲 0.5 ms、控制延遲 1.0 ms、致動回應 2.0 ms，名義總延遲=3.5 ms。若各自獨立最大界限另加 0.2、0.3、0.5 ms，保守相加為 4.5 ms。這只是排程上界，不是安全暴露時間，也不推定任何雷射等級合格。
workedExample.textEn: Non-emitting logic example: detection 0.5 ms, control 1.0 ms and actuation 2.0 ms total 3.5 ms. Adding separate worst-case allowances of 0.2, 0.3 and 0.5 ms gives 4.5 ms. This scheduling bound is not a safe exposure time and establishes no laser-class compliance.
workedExample.assumptions: 只模擬非發光狀態與邏輯；實際雷射操作、分類和測試由合格人員與設備完成。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Simulate only non-emitting states/logic; real operation, classification and testing require qualified personnel and equipment.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

title: 台積電 CoWoS 整合案例
summary: 從CoWoS 變體、中介層、HBM 與封裝整合拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate CoWoS variants, interposers, HBM and package integration, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設有效直線互連邊長 10 mm、單列節距 50 µm，理想位置數 floor(10000/50)=200。若教學預留40個供電/接地、20個備用，最多140個訊號位置。此一維上限未包含多列、禁佈區和布線可達性，不是 CoWoS 公開或保密的實際節距。
workedExample.textEn: Assume 10 mm effective shoreline and 50 µm single-row pitch: floor(10000/50)=200 positions. Reserving 40 for power/ground and 20 spare leaves at most 140 signals. This 1D bound excludes multiple rows, keepouts and routability and is not a CoWoS process pitch.
workedExample.assumptions: 假想一維幾何，只用來練習介面預算；實際設計須取得供應商平台規則。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Hypothetical 1D geometry for interface budgeting; real design requires supplier platform rules.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

title: 台積電 SoIC 堆疊整合案例
summary: 從SoIC 垂直分割、接合界面與後段整合拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate SoIC vertical partitioning, bonding interfaces and downstream integration, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設四顆晶粒在既定篩選後各有 0.99 的可用機率，三個接合界面各有 0.995 的成功機率，且所有事件獨立，則 Y=0.99⁴×0.995³=0.9463，約94.63%。這是未提供重工的教學模型；若有共同污染、測試漏失相關或挑選配對，應改用條件機率，不能當成 SoIC 量產良率。
workedExample.textEn: Assume four screened dies each have 0.99 usable probability and three interfaces each have 0.995 success, all independent: Y=0.99⁴×0.995³=0.9463 or 94.63%. This no-rework teaching model is not SoIC production yield; common contamination, correlated escapes or selection require conditional probabilities.
workedExample.assumptions: 假想獨立事件、固定測試覆蓋及無重工；不包含供應商未公開參數。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Hypothetical independent events, fixed test coverage and no rework; no undisclosed vendor parameters.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

title: Intel Foveros 封裝案例
summary: 從Foveros 平台變體與立體功能分割拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate Foveros variants and three-dimensional functional partitioning, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設互連等效 C=20 fF、電壓 V=0.7 V：電容儲能½CV²=4.9 fJ。理想電阻充電時電源供能 CV²=9.8 fJ，其中一半在充電路徑耗散；完整充放電週期從電源取9.8 fJ。若活動率定義為每週期0→1機率，P=αCV²f；不能把4.9 fJ稱為完整晶片每位元能量。
workedExample.textEn: For C=20 fF and V=0.7 V, stored energy ½CV²=4.9 fJ. A resistive charge draws CV²=9.8 fJ from the supply, half dissipated during charging; a full charge/discharge cycle draws 9.8 fJ. If α is the probability of a 0-to-1 event per cycle, P=αCV²f. The 4.9 fJ is not full-chip energy per bit.
workedExample.assumptions: 理想線性電容與電阻充放電，排除漏電、短路、驅動器、時鐘和協議開銷；數值不是 Foveros 規格。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Ideal linear capacitor/resistive charging excludes leakage, short-circuit, drivers, clocks and protocol overhead; values are not Foveros specifications.

steps.instruction: 先以師傅示意確認「接合路線」的輸入、輸出與座標，再在學徒工作台完成對應元件或資料流的排列。微凸塊和直接銅接合的幾何、材料及熱機械界面不同，不能共用所有設計規則。 用本單元的變數畫出至少兩種設計狀態，說明它們在「比較公開結構的寄生與缺陷類型，不捏造製程節距或配方。」的驗證中應有何差異；把待量測參數另列，不以動畫位置當成實際公差。 假設互連等效 C=20 fF、電壓 V=0.7 V：電容儲能½CV²=4.9 fJ。理想電阻充電時電源供能 CV²=9.8 fJ，其中一半在充電路徑耗散；完整充放電週期從電源取9.8 fJ。若活動率定義為每週期0→1機率，P=αCV²f；不能把4.9 fJ稱為完整晶片每位元能量。
steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for bonding choices, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. Microbumps and direct copper bonding differ in geometry, materials and thermomechanical interfaces. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Compare public structures' parasitics/defects without inventing pitch or recipes. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances. For C=20 fF and V=0.7 V, stored energy ½CV²=4.9 fJ. A resistive charge draws CV²=9.8 fJ from the supply, half dissipated during charging; a full charge/discharge cycle draws 9.8 fJ. If α is the probability of a 0-to-1 event per cycle, P=αCV²f. The 4.9 fJ is not full-chip energy per bit.

steps.title: 接合路線：量測與判別
steps.objective: 以「接合路線」區分機制並作出有證據的驗收決定，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。

Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "Microbumps and direct copper bonding differ in geometry, materials and thermomechanical interfaces." against the incorrect hypothesis "Every Foveros variant has identical bonding material and architecture."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model. For C=20 fF and V=0.7 V, stored energy ½CV²=4.9 fJ. A resistive charge draws CV²=9.8 fJ from the supply, half dissipated during charging; a full charge/discharge cycle draws 9.8 fJ. If α is the probability of a 0-to-1 event per cycle, P=αCV²f. The 4.9 fJ is not full-chip energy per bit.

steps.observationEn: Compare public structures' parasitics/defects without inventing pitch or recipes.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：所有 Foveros 變體都具有完全相同的接合材料和架構。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。

knowledge.title: 量化模型與適用邊界
knowledge.text: Estored=½CV²；Esupply,charge=CV²；Pdynamic=αCV²f，α須明確定義。 理想線性電容與電阻充放電，排除漏電、短路、驅動器、時鐘和協議開銷；數值不是 Foveros 規格。

quiz.question: 要審查「訊號與返回」，哪項主張或驗證方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or verification is justified when reviewing signals and returns?
options: 電容儲能就是完整系統每位元能量。
垂直堆疊縮小面積就必然降低所有熱點溫度。
高密度接點仍需足夠返回電流通路，不是所有接點都能計為資料位元。
optionsEn: Capacitor stored energy equals full-system energy per bit.
Smaller stacked footprint necessarily lowers every hotspot.
Dense contacts still need returns; not every contact is a data bit.
quiz.explanation: 高密度接點仍需足夠返回電流通路，不是所有接點都能計為資料位元。 從總接點扣除電源、接地、時鐘與測試，重算可用訊號。

steps.title: 訊號與返回：量測與判別
steps.titleEn: Signals and returns: measurement and diagnosis
steps.objective: 以「訊號與返回」區分機制並作出有證據的驗收決定，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。

steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Deduct power, ground, clocks and test from contact count to recalculate signals. Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "Dense contacts still need returns; not every contact is a data bit." against the incorrect hypothesis "Smaller stacked footprint necessarily lowers every hotspot."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model.
steps.observation: 從總接點扣除電源、接地、時鐘與測試，重算可用訊號。

steps.check: 提交訊號與返回的量測判別表：從總接點扣除電源、接地、時鐘與測試，重算可用訊號。 附上基準、重複性或不確定度，及不能由本資料判定的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit a measurement-discrimination table for signals and returns: Deduct power, ground, clocks and test from contact count to recalculate signals. Include the reference, repeatability or uncertainty, and conclusions the data cannot support.

title: Intel EMIB 互連橋案例
summary: 從EMIB 嵌入式橋接、返回路徑與組合封裝拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate EMIB embedded bridges, return paths and package composition, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假想均勻傳輸線長 L=5 mm、有效相對介電常數 εeff=4，v≈c/√εeff=1.50×10⁸ m/s，因此單向傳播延遲約33.3 ps。若資料單位間隔 UI=100 ps，此延遲為0.333 UI，但固定延遲不是同量的抖動或眼圖閉合。這不是 EMIB 產品長度或材料規格。
workedExample.textEn: For a hypothetical 5 mm uniform line with εeff=4, v≈c/√εeff=1.50×10⁸ m/s, giving about 33.3 ps one-way delay. At a 100 ps UI this is 0.333 UI; fixed delay is not equivalent jitter or eye closure. These are not EMIB product dimensions/materials.
workedExample.assumptions: 準 TEM、均勻有效介質與固定頻段的教學近似，未包含接點不連續及導體損耗。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Teaching quasi-TEM uniform-effective-medium approximation over a fixed band; contact discontinuities and conductor loss are excluded.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

title: imec iSiPP 矽光子平台
summary: 從iSiPP 平台選擇、授權設計與驗證交付拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate iSiPP platform selection, licensed design and verification handoff, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假想環形腔光路長 L=1 mm、群折射率 ng=4、中心波長 λ=1550 nm。小範圍近似 FSRλ≈λ²/(ngL)=1550²/(4×1,000,000)=0.6006 nm；頻率間距 c/(ngL)≈74.95 GHz。這只估計間距，不提供共振線寬、Q 或插入損耗，也不是 iSiPP 的元件規格。
workedExample.textEn: For a hypothetical ring of path length 1 mm, group index 4 and wavelength 1550 nm, the local FSR approximation is λ²/(ngL)=0.6006 nm; frequency spacing is c/(ngL)≈74.95 GHz. This estimates spacing, not linewidth, Q or insertion loss, and is not an iSiPP device specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 單一模態、局部近似與假想群折射率；未包含耦合器相位色散、溫度漂移及實際製程分布。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Single mode, local approximation and hypothetical group index; coupler phase dispersion, thermal drift and process distributions are excluded.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

knowledge.textEn: Compare two- and four-pole speed tables. Retain references, units and uncertainty; without measured data, interpret hypothetical cases only.

knowledge.title: 本課量化連結
knowledge.text: 教學假設二極同步機接 60 Hz：n=120f/p=3600 rpm；若輸出 100 MW、效率 98%，輸入 102.041 MW、損失 2.041 MW。效率為假設且未含汽輪機熱效率。
knowledge.textEn: Assume a two-pole synchronous machine at 60 Hz: n=120f/p=3600 rpm. At 100 MW output and assumed 98% efficiency, input is 102.041 MW and loss 2.041 MW; turbine thermal efficiency is excluded.

quiz.question: 審查「極數與轉速」時，哪個判斷或驗證方法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or check is justified for poles and speed?
options: 同步轉速由頻率與極數共同決定。
只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「極數與轉速」的驗證。
只調整「極數與轉速」的顯示結果吻合，便可當作獨立量測證據。
optionsEn: Frequency and pole count jointly determine synchronous speed.
Equal nominal ratings justify skipping poles and speed verification.
Tuning the displayed poles and speed result to match counts as independent measurement evidence.
quiz.explanation: 同步轉速由頻率與極數共同決定。 比較二極與四極的轉速表。
quiz.explanationEn: Frequency and pole count jointly determine synchronous speed. Compare two- and four-pole speed tables.

steps.title: 極數與轉速：量測與判讀
steps.titleEn: Poles and speed: measurement and diagnosis
steps.objective: 針對「極數與轉速」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for poles and speed.
steps.instruction: 先重播本單元模型，讀取兩種假想情境而不接觸真實帶電設備。比較二極與四極的轉速表。 比較差異是否符合「同步轉速由頻率與極數共同決定。」；列出至少兩個競爭原因，指定能區分原因的新增量測。先依專案規格訂接受條件，再納入量測不確定度，將未驗證項保持為未決。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit model and inspect two hypothetical cases without accessing energized equipment. Compare two- and four-pole speed tables. Compare the result against: Frequency and pole count jointly determine synchronous speed. List at least two competing causes and select an additional discriminating measurement. Define acceptance from project requirements before observing results, include uncertainty and retain unverified items as unresolved.
steps.observation: 比較二極與四極的轉速表。
steps.observationEn: Compare two- and four-pole speed tables.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「極數與轉速」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping poles and speed verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「極數與轉速」的量測比較、誤差來源及放行／保留理由；不能用單一平均值掩蓋最差條件。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement comparison, error sources and accept/hold rationale for poles and speed; do not hide limiting conditions behind one average.

steps.title: 磁通與端電壓：模型與設計
steps.titleEn: Flux and voltage: model and design
steps.objective: 針對「磁通與端電壓」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for flux and voltage.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，標出「磁通與端電壓」的輸入、輸出及量測基準，再在學徒工作台排列對應元件或資料流。感應電壓隨頻率、匝數與每極磁通變化。 在離線草圖或試算表建立基準與擾動兩種情境，寫出因果預測；用「固定頻率檢查匝數變更的比例。」規劃如何反駁模型。把未知參數、單位與邊界記錄在學習筆記。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor diagram, identify inputs, outputs and references for flux and voltage, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Induced voltage depends on frequency, turns and pole flux. Build baseline and perturbed cases offline and predict causality. Plan a falsification using: Check turn-ratio scaling at fixed frequency. Record unknown parameters, units and boundaries in your learning notes.
steps.observation: 固定頻率檢查匝數變更的比例。
steps.observationEn: Check turn-ratio scaling at fixed frequency.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「磁通與端電壓」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping flux and voltage verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「磁通與端電壓」的兩情境模型、單位表及可反駁預測；說明「固定頻率檢查匝數變更的比例。」如何區分情境。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case model, units and a falsifiable prediction for flux and voltage; explain how the proposed check distinguishes cases.

steps.instruction: 先重播本單元模型，讀取兩種假想情境而不接觸真實帶電設備。比較相同幾何的 1.0 與 1.1 倍轉速。 比較差異是否符合「轉速提高使離心應力約隨轉速平方增加。」；列出至少兩個競爭原因，指定能區分原因的新增量測。先依專案規格訂接受條件，再納入量測不確定度，將未驗證項保持為未決。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit model and inspect two hypothetical cases without accessing energized equipment. Compare equal geometry at 1.0 and 1.1 speed. Compare the result against: Centrifugal stress scales approximately with squared speed. List at least two competing causes and select an additional discriminating measurement. Define acceptance from project requirements before observing results, include uncertainty and retain unverified items as unresolved.
steps.observation: 比較相同幾何的 1.0 與 1.1 倍轉速。
steps.observationEn: Compare equal geometry at 1.0 and 1.1 speed.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「轉子圓周應力」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping rotor hoop stress verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「轉子圓周應力」的量測比較、誤差來源及放行／保留理由；不能用單一平均值掩蓋最差條件。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement comparison, error sources and accept/hold rationale for rotor hoop stress; do not hide limiting conditions behind one average.

knowledge.title: 本單元機制
knowledge.text: 轉速提高使離心應力約隨轉速平方增加。
knowledge.textEn: Centrifugal stress scales approximately with squared speed.

knowledge.title: 可區分原因的證據
knowledge.text: 比較相同幾何的 1.0 與 1.1 倍轉速。 必須保留基準、單位及不確定度，未有實測資料時只做假想案例判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Compare equal geometry at 1.0 and 1.1 speed. Retain references, units and uncertainty; without measured data, interpret hypothetical cases only.

Compare equal geometry at 1.0 and 1.1 speed.

quiz.explanation: 轉速提高使離心應力約隨轉速平方增加。 比較相同幾何的 1.0 與 1.1 倍轉速。

summary: 以轉速、電磁負載與轉子熱機械限制串連 12 個技術單元；新增 24 步，包含原理、假想算例、量測設計、失效辨識與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units connect speed, electromagnetic loading and rotor thermomechanical limits through 24 new tasks with principles, hypothetical calculations, measurement design, failure discrimination and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的離線工程教育與報告判讀。數值為自行設定的教學假設，非產品保證、現場整定、製造配方或帶電操作程序；高壓、旋轉與大型設備實務由合格團隊依正式規格驗證。完成課程不是專業執照。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.

steps.instruction: 先重播本單元模型，讀取兩種假想情境而不接觸真實帶電設備。配對圓周氣隙圖和振動方向。 比較差異是否符合「非均勻氣隙造成不平衡磁拉力。」；列出至少兩個競爭原因，指定能區分原因的新增量測。先依專案規格訂接受條件，再納入量測不確定度，將未驗證項保持為未決。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit model and inspect two hypothetical cases without accessing energized equipment. Pair circumferential gap maps with vibration direction. Compare the result against: Nonuniform gaps create unbalanced magnetic pull. List at least two competing causes and select an additional discriminating measurement. Define acceptance from project requirements before observing results, include uncertainty and retain unverified items as unresolved.
steps.observation: 配對圓周氣隙圖和振動方向。
steps.observationEn: Pair circumferential gap maps with vibration direction.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「氣隙偏心」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。

steps.check: 提交「氣隙偏心」的量測比較、誤差來源及放行／保留理由；不能用單一平均值掩蓋最差條件。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement comparison, error sources and accept/hold rationale for air-gap eccentricity; do not hide limiting conditions behind one average.

knowledge.title: 本單元機制

knowledge.title: 可區分原因的證據
knowledge.text: 配對圓周氣隙圖和振動方向。 必須保留基準、單位及不確定度，未有實測資料時只做假想案例判讀。

optionsEn: Pair circumferential gap maps with vibration direction.

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor diagram, identify inputs, outputs and references for thrust bearing, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case model, units and a falsifiable prediction for thrust bearing; explain how the proposed check distinguishes cases.
